verses.text: One of them, when he saw that he was healed, turned back, glorifying God with a loud voice. He fell on his face at Jesus’ feet, giving him thanks; and he was a Samaritan.
verses.meaning: Ten were healed, but only one came back to say thank you. Don’t let God’s kindness to you go unthanked.
verses.kjv: And one of them, when he saw that he was healed, turned back, and with a loud voice glorified God, And fell down on his face at his feet, giving him thanks: and he was a Samaritan.

verses.text: Now before the feast of the Passover, Jesus, knowing that his time had come that he would depart from this world to the Father, having loved his own who were in the world, he loved them to the end.
verses.meaning: Knowing what was coming, Jesus kept loving his friends all the way to the end. His love doesn’t quit.
verses.kjv: Now before the feast of the passover, when Jesus knew that his hour was come that he should depart out of this world unto the Father, having loved his own which were in the world, he loved them unto the end.

verses.text: His lord said to him, ‘Well done, good and faithful servant. You have been faithful over a few things, I will set you over many things. Enter into the joy of your lord.’
verses.meaning: In Jesus’s story, faithfulness in small things is what the master celebrates. Little tasks done well count.
verses.kjv: His lord said unto him, Well done, thou good and faithful servant: thou hast been faithful over a few things, I will make thee ruler over many things: enter thou into the joy of thy lord.

verses.text: The remnant of Israel will not do iniquity nor speak lies, neither will a deceitful tongue be found in their mouth, for they will feed and lie down, and no one will make them afraid.
verses.meaning: God’s renewed people are honest through and through, and they eat and lie down with no one to fear.
verses.kjv: The remnant of Israel shall not do iniquity, nor speak lies; neither shall a deceitful tongue be found in their mouth: for they shall feed and lie down, and none shall make them afraid.

verses.text: Hope deferred makes the heart sick, but when longing is fulfilled, it is a tree of life.
verses.meaning: Long waiting can make your heart ache, and that’s human. A longing fulfilled feels like new life.
verses.kjv: Hope deferred maketh the heart sick: but when the desire cometh, it is a tree of life.

verses.text: Shouldn’t you also have had mercy on your fellow servant, even as I had mercy on you?
verses.meaning: In Jesus’s story, a man let off a fortune wouldn’t forgive a small debt. Mercy you receive should flow on.
verses.kjv: Shouldest not thou also have had compassion on thy fellowservant, even as I had pity on thee?

verses.text: The following night, the Lord stood by him and said, “Cheer up, Paul, for as you have testified about me at Jerusalem, so you must testify also at Rome.”
verses.meaning: After a frightening day, the Lord stood beside Paul at night and told him to cheer up. There was work ahead.
verses.kjv: And the night following the Lord stood by him, and said, Be of good cheer, Paul: for as thou hast testified of me in Jerusalem, so must thou bear witness also at Rome.

verses.text: Remember also your Creator in the days of your youth, before the evil days come, and the years draw near, when you will say, “I have no pleasure in them…”
verses.meaning: Remember God while you’re young and strong. Don’t wait for a better season to give him your attention.
verses.kjv: Remember now thy Creator in the days of thy youth, while the evil days come not, nor the years draw nigh, when thou shalt say, I have no pleasure in them…

verses.text: He said to him, ‘Son, you are always with me, and all that is mine is yours.’
verses.meaning: The father reminded his resentful older son: you’ve always belonged here, and all I have is yours.
verses.kjv: And he said unto him, Son, thou art ever with me, and all that I have is thine.

verses.text: The poor and needy seek water, and there is none. Their tongue fails for thirst. I, the LORD, will answer them. I, the God of Israel, will not forsake them.
verses.meaning: When you’re parched and out of options, God hears you. He doesn’t abandon people in need.
verses.kjv: When the poor and needy seek water, and there is none, and their tongue faileth for thirst, I the LORD will hear them, I the God of Israel will not forsake them.

verses.text: It shall not be so among you; but whoever desires to become great among you shall be your servant. Whoever desires to be first among you shall be your bondservant, even as the Son of Man came not to be served, but to serve, and to give his life as a ransom for many.
verses.meaning: In God’s kingdom, greatness means serving. Jesus himself came to serve and give his life for others.
verses.kjv: But it shall not be so among you: but whosoever will be great among you, let him be your minister; And whosoever will be chief among you, let him be your servant: Even as the Son of man came not to be ministered unto, but to minister, and to give his life a ransom for many.

verses.text: In that day I will make a covenant for them with the animals of the field, and with the birds of the sky, and with the creeping things of the ground. I will break the bow, the sword, and the battle out of the land, and will make them lie down safely.
verses.meaning: God pictures a day when weapons are broken and his people lie down safe, at peace even with creation.
verses.kjv: And in that day will I make a covenant for them with the beasts of the field, and with the fowls of heaven, and with the creeping things of the ground: and I will break the bow and the sword and the battle out of the earth, and will make them to lie down safely.

verses.text: Behold, we call them blessed who endured. You have heard of the perseverance of Job and have seen the Lord in the outcome, and how the Lord is full of compassion and mercy.
verses.meaning: Job’s story shows that holding on through suffering is worth it, because God’s heart is full of mercy.
verses.kjv: Behold, we count them happy which endure. Ye have heard of the patience of Job, and have seen the end of the Lord; that the Lord is very pitiful, and of tender mercy.

verses.text: Hezekiah received the letter from the hand of the messengers and read it. Then Hezekiah went up to the LORD’s house, and spread it before the LORD.
verses.meaning: Handed a threatening letter, Hezekiah laid it out before God. You can spread your worries out before him too.
verses.kjv: And Hezekiah received the letter of the hand of the messengers, and read it: and Hezekiah went up into the house of the LORD, and spread it before the LORD.

verses.text: They worshiped him and returned to Jerusalem with great joy, and were continually in the temple, praising and blessing God. Amen.
verses.meaning: After Jesus returned to heaven, his friends weren’t gloomy. They were full of joy and kept praising God.
verses.kjv: And they worshipped him, and returned to Jerusalem with great joy: And were continually in the temple, praising and blessing God. Amen.

verses.text: If you love me, keep my commandments.
verses.meaning: Love for Jesus isn’t just a feeling. It shows up in the choices you make to live the way he taught.
verses.kjv: If ye love me, keep my commandments.

verses.text: Go and make disciples of all nations, baptizing them in the name of the Father and of the Son and of the Holy Spirit…
verses.meaning: Jesus sent his followers out to help every nation know and follow him. That mission still includes you.
verses.kjv: Go ye therefore, and teach all nations, baptizing them in the name of the Father, and of the Son, and of the Holy Ghost…

verses.text: Behold, a violent storm came up on the sea, so much that the boat was covered with the waves; but he was asleep.
verses.meaning: A storm was swamping the boat, and Jesus slept. Rest can be an act of trust in the Father.
verses.kjv: And, behold, there arose a great tempest in the sea, insomuch that the ship was covered with the waves: but he was asleep.

verses.text: For you are my lamp, LORD. The LORD will light up my darkness.
verses.meaning: When everything around you is dark, God can be the lamp that lights your next step.
verses.kjv: For thou art my lamp, O LORD: and the LORD will lighten my darkness.

verses.text: For this is my blood of the new covenant, which is poured out for many for the remission of sins.
verses.meaning: At the Last Supper, Jesus explained his coming death: his life poured out so sins could be forgiven.
verses.kjv: For this is my blood of the new testament, which is shed for many for the remission of sins.

verses.text: But Peter and the apostles answered, “We must obey God rather than men.”
verses.meaning: Ordered to stop talking about Jesus, the apostles said God’s voice comes before anyone else’s.
verses.kjv: Then Peter and the other apostles answered and said, We ought to obey God rather than men.

verses.text: The Lord GOD has given me the tongue of those who are taught, that I may know how to sustain with words him who is weary. He awakens morning by morning, he awakens my ear to hear as those who are taught.
verses.meaning: Morning by morning God wakes your ear to listen, so you’ll have words that lift up someone tired.
verses.kjv: The Lord GOD hath given me the tongue of the learned, that I should know how to speak a word in season to him that is weary: he wakeneth morning by morning, he wakeneth mine ear to hear as the learned.

verses.text: The gatekeeper opens the gate for him, and the sheep listen to his voice. He calls his own sheep by name and leads them out.
verses.meaning: Jesus knows you by name, not as a face in the crowd. He calls you personally and leads the way.
verses.kjv: To him the porter openeth; and the sheep hear his voice: and he calleth his own sheep by name, and leadeth them out.

verses.text: I will feed them with good pasture, and their fold will be on the mountains of the height of Israel. There they will lie down in a good fold. They will feed on rich pasture on the mountains of Israel.
verses.meaning: God promises to be the shepherd his people never had, leading them to good pasture and a safe place to rest.
verses.kjv: I will feed them in a good pasture, and upon the high mountains of Israel shall their fold be: there shall they lie in a good fold, and in a fat pasture shall they feed upon the mountains of Israel.

verses.text: For I was hungry and you gave me food to eat. I was thirsty and you gave me drink. I was a stranger and you took me in. I was naked and you clothed me. I was sick and you visited me. I was in prison and you came to me.
verses.meaning: Feeding the hungry, welcoming strangers, visiting the sick and the jailed: Jesus counts it as done to him.
verses.kjv: For I was an hungred, and ye gave me meat: I was thirsty, and ye gave me drink: I was a stranger, and ye took me in: Naked, and ye clothed me: I was sick, and ye visited me: I was in prison, and ye came unto me.

verses.text: ‘In that day,’ says the LORD of Armies, ‘you will invite every man his neighbor under the vine and under the fig tree.’
verses.meaning: In God’s promised future, neighbors invite each other to sit in the shade together. That’s his peace.
verses.kjv: In that day, saith the LORD of hosts, shall ye call every man his neighbour under the vine and under the fig tree.

verses.text: Therefore put on the whole armor of God, that you may be able to withstand in the evil day, and having done all, to stand.
verses.meaning: On the hardest days, God gives you what you need to stand. Sometimes still standing is the victory.
verses.kjv: Wherefore take unto you the whole armour of God, that ye may be able to withstand in the evil day, and having done all, to stand.

verses.text: Then the king said to me, “What is your request?” So I prayed to the God of heaven.
verses.meaning: Put on the spot by a king, Nehemiah breathed a quick prayer before he answered. Short prayers count.
verses.kjv: Then the king said unto me, For what dost thou make request? So I prayed to the God of heaven.

verses.text: Coming up at that very hour, she gave thanks to the Lord, and spoke of him to all those who were looking for redemption in Jerusalem.
verses.meaning: Anna had waited and prayed for decades. When she finally saw baby Jesus, she thanked God and spread the news.
verses.kjv: And she coming in that instant gave thanks likewise unto the Lord, and spake of him to all them that looked for redemption in Jerusalem.

verses.text: Jesus answered him, “If a man loves me, he will keep my word. My Father will love him, and we will come to him and make our home with him.”
verses.meaning: Loving Jesus shows in how you live, and he promises he and the Father will make their home with you.
verses.kjv: Jesus answered and said unto him, If a man love me, he will keep my words: and my Father will love him, and we will come unto him, and make our abode with him.

verses.text: For the Son of Man also came not to be served but to serve, and to give his life as a ransom for many.
verses.meaning: Jesus didn’t come to be waited on. He came to serve and give his life, and that’s the pattern for yours.
verses.kjv: For even the Son of man came not to be ministered unto, but to minister, and to give his life a ransom for many.

verses.text: Now when Jesus heard this, he withdrew from there in a boat to a deserted place apart. When the multitudes heard it, they followed him on foot from the cities.
verses.meaning: When Jesus heard John the Baptist had been killed, he went off alone. Grief needs quiet space.
verses.kjv: When Jesus heard of it, he departed thence by ship into a desert place apart: and when the people had heard thereof, they followed him on foot out of the cities.

verses.text: For we were saved in hope, but hope that is seen is not hope. For who hopes for that which he sees? But if we hope for that which we don’t see, we wait for it with patience.
verses.meaning: Hope is for what you can’t see yet. That’s why it takes patience, and why it’s worth it.
verses.kjv: For we are saved by hope: but hope that is seen is not hope: for what a man seeth, why doth he yet hope for? But if we hope for that we see not, then do we with patience wait for it.

verses.text: When Jesus heard it, he said to them, “Those who are healthy have no need for a physician, but those who are sick. I came not to call the righteous, but sinners to repentance.”
verses.meaning: Jesus didn’t come for people who think they have it all together. He came for the ones who know they need him.
verses.kjv: When Jesus heard it, he saith unto them, They that are whole have no need of the physician, but they that are sick: I came not to call the righteous, but sinners to repentance.

verses.text: But Barnabas took him and brought him to the apostles, and declared to them how he had seen the Lord on the way, and that he had spoken to him, and how at Damascus he had preached boldly in the name of Jesus.
verses.meaning: Everyone feared Saul, but Barnabas stood up for him. Brave kindness can change someone’s whole story.
verses.kjv: But Barnabas took him, and brought him to the apostles, and declared unto them how he had seen the Lord in the way, and that he had spoken to him, and how he had preached boldly at Damascus in the name of Jesus.

verses.text: Why do you spend money for that which is not bread, and your labor for that which doesn’t satisfy? Listen diligently to me, and eat that which is good, and let your soul delight itself in richness.
verses.meaning: Why keep spending yourself on what never satisfies? God invites you to listen to him and be truly fed.
verses.kjv: Wherefore do ye spend money for that which is not bread? and your labour for that which satisfieth not? hearken diligently unto me, and eat ye that which is good, and let your soul delight itself in fatness.

verses.text: In that day you will know that I am in my Father, and you in me, and I in you.
verses.meaning: Jesus promised his friends they would see it: he’s in the Father, you’re in him, and he’s in you.
verses.kjv: At that day ye shall know that I am in my Father, and ye in me, and I in you.

verses.text: I drew them with cords of a man, with ties of love; and I was to them like those who lift up the yoke on their necks; and I bent down to him and I fed him.
verses.meaning: Like a parent stooping to feed a toddler, God bends low to care for you, drawing you with love, not force.
verses.kjv: I drew them with cords of a man, with bands of love: and I was to them as they that take off the yoke on their jaws, and I laid meat unto them.

verses.text: Four people came, carrying a paralytic to him. When they could not come near to him for the crowd, they removed the roof where he was. When they had broken it up, they let down the mat that the paralytic was lying on.
verses.meaning: Four friends dug through a roof to get their friend to Jesus. Love finds a way when the door is blocked.
verses.kjv: And they come unto him, bringing one sick of the palsy, which was borne of four. And when they could not come nigh unto him for the press, they uncovered the roof where he was: and when they had broken it up, they let down the bed wherein the sick of the palsy lay.

verses.text: These are the things that you shall do: speak every man the truth with his neighbor. Execute the judgment of truth and peace in your gates…
verses.meaning: Peace in a community is built on plain honesty: tell your neighbor the truth and judge fairly.
verses.kjv: These are the things that ye shall do; Speak ye every man the truth to his neighbour; execute the judgment of truth and peace in your gates…

verses.text: I told them about the hand of my God which was good on me, and also about the king’s words that he had spoken to me. They said, “Let’s rise up and build.” So they strengthened their hands for the good work.
verses.meaning: Hearing how God had helped Nehemiah, the people said let’s build, and found fresh strength for good work.
verses.kjv: Then I told them of the hand of my God which was good upon me; as also the king’s words that he had spoken unto me. And they said, Let us rise up and build. So they strengthened their hands for this good work.

verses.text: But whoever listens to me will dwell securely, and will be at ease, without fear of harm.
verses.meaning: Wisdom makes a promise: listen to her and you can live settled and secure, not always on edge.
verses.kjv: But whoso hearkeneth unto me shall dwell safely, and shall be quiet from fear of evil.

verses.text: Immediately he received his sight and followed him, glorifying God. All the people, when they saw it, praised God.
verses.meaning: The man who got his sight back used it to follow Jesus, praising God, and his joy spread to the whole crowd.
verses.kjv: And immediately he received his sight, and followed him, glorifying God: and all the people, when they saw it, gave praise unto God.

verses.text: For the Father himself loves you, because you have loved me, and have believed that I came from God.
verses.meaning: Jesus wanted his friends to know the Father himself loves them. You don’t need to win God over.
verses.kjv: For the Father himself loveth you, because ye have loved me, and have believed that I came out from God.

verses.text: Mary said, “Behold, the servant of the Lord; let it be done to me according to your word.” Then the angel departed from her.
verses.meaning: Mary didn’t have the whole plan, but she said yes to God anyway. Surrender can be a brave, simple word.
verses.kjv: And Mary said, Behold the handmaid of the Lord; be it unto me according to thy word. And the angel departed from her.

verses.text: He commanded them that everyone should sit down in groups on the green grass.
verses.meaning: Before feeding the crowd, Jesus had everyone sit down on the green grass. He makes room for you to rest.
verses.kjv: And he commanded them to make all sit down by companies upon the green grass.

verses.text: For the creation was subjected to vanity, not of its own will, but because of him who subjected it, in hope that the creation itself also will be delivered from the bondage of decay into the liberty of the glory of the children of God.
verses.meaning: All of creation is waiting in hope. One day God will free it from decay, along with his children.
verses.kjv: For the creature was made subject to vanity, not willingly, but by reason of him who hath subjected the same in hope, Because the creature itself also shall be delivered from the bondage of corruption into the glorious liberty of the children of God.

verses.text: But I tell you who hear: love your enemies, do good to those who hate you, bless those who curse you, and pray for those who mistreat you.
verses.meaning: Jesus calls you to bless even your enemies. That doesn’t mean staying where they can keep hurting you.
verses.kjv: But I say unto you which hear, Love your enemies, do good to them which hate you, Bless them that curse you, and pray for them which despitefully use you.

verses.text: In him we have boldness and access in confidence through our faith in him.
verses.meaning: Because of Jesus, you can come to God with confidence instead of fear or hesitation.
verses.kjv: In whom we have boldness and access with confidence by the faith of him.

verses.text: Your words were found, and I ate them. Your words were to me a joy and the rejoicing of my heart, for I am called by your name, LORD, God of Armies.
verses.meaning: Jeremiah found God’s words and devoured them, and they became his joy. Feed on what actually fills you.
verses.kjv: Thy words were found, and I did eat them; and thy word was unto me the joy and rejoicing of mine heart: for I am called by thy name, O LORD God of hosts.

verses.text: I in them, and you in me, that they may be perfected into one, that the world may know that you sent me and loved them, even as you loved me.
verses.meaning: Jesus prayed that the world would see God loves you just as much as he loves his own Son.
verses.kjv: I in them, and thou in me, that they may be made perfect in one; and that the world may know that thou hast sent me, and hast loved them, as thou hast loved me.

verses.text: Therefore don’t be like them, for your Father knows what things you need before you ask him.
verses.meaning: You don’t have to convince God with long speeches. Your Father already knows what you need.
verses.kjv: Be not ye therefore like unto them: for your Father knoweth what things ye have need of, before ye ask him.

verses.text: “Now which of these three do you think seemed to be a neighbor to him who fell among the robbers?” He said, “He who showed mercy on him.” Then Jesus said to him, “Go and do likewise.”
verses.meaning: A neighbor isn’t defined by where they live. It’s whoever shows mercy, and Jesus says go do the same.
verses.kjv: Which now of these three, thinkest thou, was neighbour unto him that fell among the thieves? And he said, He that shewed mercy on him. Then said Jesus unto him, Go, and do thou likewise.

verses.text: Now you are releasing your servant, Master, according to your word, in peace; for my eyes have seen your salvation…
verses.meaning: Old Simeon held baby Jesus and felt ready to go in peace. Seeing God keep his word settles a heart.
verses.kjv: Lord, now lettest thou thy servant depart in peace, according to thy word: For mine eyes have seen thy salvation…

verses.text: You have also given me the shield of your salvation. Your right hand sustains me. Your gentleness has made me great.
verses.meaning: God shields you and holds you up, and it’s his gentleness with you, not harshness, that helps you grow strong.
verses.kjv: Thou hast also given me the shield of thy salvation: and thy right hand hath holden me up, and thy gentleness hath made me great.

verses.text: In the fear of the LORD is a secure fortress, and he will be a refuge for his children.
verses.meaning: Honoring God gives you a strong place to stand, and he becomes a shelter for his children.
verses.kjv: In the fear of the LORD is strong confidence: and his children shall have a place of refuge.

verses.text: Jesus took the loaves, and having given thanks, he distributed to the disciples, and the disciples to those who were sitting down, likewise also of the fish as much as they desired.
verses.meaning: Jesus gave thanks over one boy’s small lunch before it fed a crowd. Thanks belongs even to little things.
verses.kjv: And Jesus took the loaves; and when he had given thanks, he distributed to the disciples, and the disciples to them that were set down; and likewise of the fishes as much as they would.

verses.text: Who shall separate us from the love of Christ? Could oppression, or anguish, or persecution, or famine, or nakedness, or peril, or sword?
verses.meaning: No hardship, danger or loss can pull you away from Christ’s love. It holds on through everything.
verses.kjv: Who shall separate us from the love of Christ? shall tribulation, or distress, or persecution, or famine, or nakedness, or peril, or sword?

verses.text: He who is faithful in a very little is faithful also in much. He who is dishonest in a very little is also dishonest in much.
verses.meaning: How you handle small things shows who you are. Faithfulness starts with the little, unseen stuff.
verses.kjv: He that is faithful in that which is least is faithful also in much: and he that is unjust in the least is unjust also in much.

verses.text: She had a sister called Mary, who also sat at Jesus’ feet and heard his word.
verses.meaning: Mary sat at Jesus’s feet just listening. Sometimes the best thing you can do is stop and be with him.
verses.kjv: And she had a sister called Mary, which also sat at Jesus’ feet, and heard his word.

verses.text: For whatever things were written before were written for our learning, that through perseverance and through encouragement of the Scriptures we might have hope.
verses.meaning: The Bible’s old stories were written with you in mind, to keep you going and give you hope.
verses.kjv: For whatsoever things were written aforetime were written for our learning, that we through patience and comfort of the scriptures might have hope.

verses.text: I tell you that even so there will be more joy in heaven over one sinner who repents, than over ninety-nine righteous people who need no repentance.
verses.meaning: Heaven throws a bigger party for one person who turns back to God than for ninety-nine who never strayed.
verses.kjv: I say unto you, that likewise joy shall be in heaven over one sinner that repenteth, more than over ninety and nine just persons, which need no repentance.

verses.text: Pray for me, that utterance may be given to me in opening my mouth, to make known with boldness the mystery of the Good News, for which I am an ambassador in chains; that in it I may speak boldly, as I ought to speak.
verses.meaning: Even in chains, Paul asked others to pray he’d speak boldly. It’s okay to ask for prayer for your courage.
verses.kjv: And for me, that utterance may be given unto me, that I may open my mouth boldly, to make known the mystery of the gospel, For which I am an ambassador in bonds: that therein I may speak boldly, as I ought to speak.

verses.text: Let us search and try our ways, and turn again to the LORD.
verses.meaning: Honest self-examination isn’t meant to crush you. It’s a way to look at your habits and turn back to God.
verses.kjv: Let us search and try our ways, and turn again to the LORD.

verses.text: Jesus said to her, “Don’t hold me, for I haven’t yet ascended to my Father; but go to my brothers and tell them, ‘I am ascending to my Father and your Father, to my God and your God.’”
verses.meaning: After rising, Jesus called his followers brothers and said his Father is now their Father too.
verses.kjv: Jesus saith unto her, Touch me not; for I am not yet ascended to my Father: but go to my brethren, and say unto them, I ascend unto my Father, and your Father; and to my God, and your God.

verses.text: But if God so clothes the grass of the field, which today exists and tomorrow is thrown into the oven, won’t he much more clothe you, you of little faith?
verses.meaning: Wildflowers last a day, and God still dresses them beautifully. You matter far more to him than they do.
verses.kjv: Wherefore, if God so clothe the grass of the field, which to day is, and to morrow is cast into the oven, shall he not much more clothe you, O ye of little faith?

verses.text: For who is greater, one who sits at the table, or one who serves? Isn’t it he who sits at the table? But I am among you as one who serves.
verses.meaning: Jesus, the greatest one in the room, took the servant’s place. Serving others puts you right beside him.
verses.kjv: For whether is greater, he that sitteth at meat, or he that serveth? is not he that sitteth at meat? but I am among you as he that serveth.

verses.text: He said to the woman, “Your faith has saved you. Go in peace.”
verses.meaning: A woman everyone judged left Jesus forgiven and sent off in peace. He gives peace, not shame.
verses.kjv: And he said to the woman, Thy faith hath saved thee; go in peace.

verses.text: But I will sing of your strength. Yes, I will sing aloud of your loving kindness in the morning. For you have been my high tower, a refuge in the day of my distress. To you, my strength, I will sing praises. For God is my high tower, the God of my mercy.
verses.meaning: In distress, you can still wake up singing about God’s strength. He’s your safe high place and your mercy.
verses.kjv: But I will sing of thy power; yea, I will sing aloud of thy mercy in the morning: for thou hast been my defence and refuge in the day of my trouble. Unto thee, O my strength, will I sing: for God is my defence, and the God of my mercy.

verses.text: Every word of God is flawless. He is a shield to those who take refuge in him.
verses.meaning: Everything God says holds true, and he becomes a shield for anyone who runs to him for safety.
verses.kjv: Every word of God is pure: he is a shield unto them that put their trust in him.

verses.text: So they took away the stone from the place where the dead man was lying. Jesus lifted up his eyes and said, “Father, I thank you that you listened to me.”
verses.meaning: At his friend’s tomb, Jesus thanked the Father before Lazarus ever walked out. Thank God that he hears you.
verses.kjv: Then they took away the stone from the place where the dead was laid. And Jesus lifted up his eyes, and said, Father, I thank thee that thou hast heard me.

verses.text: Owe no one anything, except to love one another; for he who loves his neighbor has fulfilled the law.
verses.meaning: Pay what you owe and keep short accounts, except one debt you never finish paying: love.
verses.kjv: Owe no man any thing, but to love one another: for he that loveth another hath fulfilled the law.

verses.text: For the Son of Man came to seek and to save that which was lost.
verses.meaning: Jesus said why he came: to look for lost people and bring them home. No one is too far for him to find.
verses.kjv: For the Son of man is come to seek and to save that which was lost.

verses.text: They returned and prepared spices and ointments. On the Sabbath they rested according to the commandment.
verses.meaning: Even in raw grief, Jesus’s followers kept the Sabbath rest. Rest can hold you on your saddest days.
verses.kjv: And they returned, and prepared spices and ointments; and rested the sabbath day according to the commandment.

verses.text: Against hope, Abraham in hope believed, to the end that he might become a father of many nations, according to that which had been spoken, “So will your offspring be.”
verses.meaning: When hope made no sense, Abraham kept hoping in God’s promise. You can hope against the odds too.
verses.kjv: Who against hope believed in hope, that he might become the father of many nations; according to that which was spoken, So shall thy seed be.

verses.text: The son said to him, ‘Father, I have sinned against heaven and in your sight. I am no longer worthy to be called your son.’ “But the father said to his servants, ‘Bring out the best robe and put it on him. Put a ring on his hand and sandals on his feet.’”
verses.meaning: The son came home with an apology speech. His father cut him off with a robe, a ring and a welcome.
verses.kjv: And the son said unto him, Father, I have sinned against heaven, and in thy sight, and am no more worthy to be called thy son. But the father said to his servants, Bring forth the best robe, and put it on him; and put a ring on his hand, and shoes on his feet…

verses.text: But we are not of those who shrink back to destruction, but of those who have faith to the saving of the soul.
verses.meaning: Faith doesn’t shrink back when things get hard. It keeps moving toward God.
verses.kjv: But we are not of them who draw back unto perdition; but of them that believe to the saving of the soul.

verses.text: But Daniel purposed in his heart that he would not defile himself with the king’s delicacies, nor with the wine which he drank. Therefore he requested of the prince of the eunuchs that he might not defile himself.
verses.meaning: Daniel decided in advance not to compromise, then politely asked for another way. Resolve plus wisdom works.
verses.kjv: But Daniel purposed in his heart that he would not defile himself with the portion of the king’s meat, nor with the wine which he drank: therefore he requested of the prince of the eunuchs that he might not defile himself.

verses.text: ‘For in him we live, move, and have our being.’ As some of your own poets have said, ‘For we are also his offspring.’
verses.meaning: Paul told a crowd in Athens that every breath you take happens in God. You’re his offspring.
verses.kjv: For in him we live, and move, and have our being; as certain also of your own poets have said, For we are also his offspring.

verses.text: If you then, being evil, know how to give good gifts to your children, how much more will your Father who is in heaven give good things to those who ask him!
verses.meaning: If imperfect parents still love giving good gifts, imagine how much more your Father in heaven wants to.
verses.kjv: If ye then, being evil, know how to give good gifts unto your children, how much more shall your Father which is in heaven give good things to them that ask him?

verses.text: If I then, the Lord and the Teacher, have washed your feet, you also ought to wash one another’s feet. For I have given you an example, that you should also do as I have done to you.
verses.meaning: Jesus washed his friends’ dirty feet, then said: do this for each other. No task is beneath love.
verses.kjv: If I then, your Lord and Master, have washed your feet; ye also ought to wash one another’s feet. For I have given you an example, that ye should do as I have done to you.

verses.text: Into whatever house you enter, first say, ‘Peace be to this house.’ If a son of peace is there, your peace will rest on him; but if not, it will return to you.
verses.meaning: Jesus told his followers to offer peace first wherever they walked in. Your blessing is never wasted.
verses.kjv: And into whatsoever house ye enter, first say, Peace be to this house. And if the son of peace be there, your peace shall rest upon it: if not, it shall turn to you again.

verses.text: Turn to me, and have mercy on me! Give your strength to your servant. Save the son of your servant.
verses.meaning: When you’re out of strength, you can simply ask: God, turn toward me, be kind to me and give me yours.
verses.kjv: O turn unto me, and have mercy upon me; give thy strength unto thy servant, and save the son of thine handmaid.

verses.text: The LORD has taken away your judgments. He has thrown out your enemy. The King of Israel, the LORD, is among you. You will not be afraid of evil any more.
verses.meaning: God promised his people that with him right there among them, they’d no longer have to live afraid of harm.
verses.kjv: The LORD hath taken away thy judgments, he hath cast out thine enemy: the king of Israel, even the LORD, is in the midst of thee: thou shalt not see evil any more.

verses.text: Leaping up, he stood and began to walk. He entered with them into the temple, walking, leaping, and praising God.
verses.meaning: Lame from birth, the man walked at last and couldn’t stay calm. Joyful thanks is allowed to be loud.
verses.kjv: And he leaping up stood, and walked, and entered with them into the temple, walking, and leaping, and praising God.

verses.text: Love doesn’t harm a neighbor. Love therefore is the fulfillment of the law.
verses.meaning: Love never sets out to hurt anyone. If you’re truly loving people, you’re doing what God asked.
verses.kjv: Love worketh no ill to his neighbour: therefore love is the fulfilling of the law.

verses.text: He must increase, but I must decrease.
verses.meaning: John the Baptist was happy to step back so Jesus could shine. Making him bigger is a freeing way to live.
verses.kjv: He must increase, but I must decrease.

verses.text: Jacob’s well was there. Jesus therefore, being tired from his journey, sat down by the well. It was about the sixth hour.
verses.meaning: Jesus got tired and sat down by a well. Being worn out isn’t a failure; he knows how it feels.
verses.kjv: Now Jacob’s well was there. Jesus therefore, being wearied with his journey, sat thus on the well: and it was about the sixth hour.

verses.text: But when this perishable body will have become imperishable, and this mortal will have put on immortality, then what is written will happen: “Death is swallowed up in victory.” “Death, where is your sting? Hades, where is your victory?”
verses.meaning: Death doesn’t win. Because of Jesus, its sting is gone and life will have the last word.
verses.kjv: So when this corruptible shall have put on incorruption, and this mortal shall have put on immortality, then shall be brought to pass the saying that is written, Death is swallowed up in victory. O death, where is thy sting? O grave, where is thy victory?

verses.text: Be careful. If your brother sins against you, rebuke him. If he repents, forgive him. If he sins against you seven times in the day, and seven times returns, saying, ‘I repent,’ you shall forgive him.
verses.meaning: Name the wrong honestly, and forgive when someone truly turns around. Truth and mercy belong together.
verses.kjv: Take heed to yourselves: If thy brother trespass against thee, rebuke him; and if he repent, forgive him. And if he trespass against thee seven times in a day, and seven times in a day turn again to thee, saying, I repent; thou shalt forgive him.

verses.text: By faith he left Egypt, not fearing the wrath of the king; for he endured, as seeing him who is invisible.
verses.meaning: Moses wasn’t ruled by an angry king’s threats. He kept his eyes on the God no one can see.
verses.kjv: By faith he forsook Egypt, not fearing the wrath of the king: for he endured, as seeing him who is invisible.

verses.text: Those who regard vain idols forsake their own mercy.
verses.meaning: Holding on to worthless things means letting go of the kindness God meant for you.
verses.kjv: They that observe lying vanities forsake their own mercy.

verses.text: Among whom you are also called to belong to Jesus Christ; to all who are in Rome, beloved of God, called to be saints: Grace to you and peace from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.
verses.meaning: Paul’s greeting to Rome fits you too: called to belong to Jesus, loved by God and set apart as his.
verses.kjv: Among whom are ye also the called of Jesus Christ: To all that be in Rome, beloved of God, called to be saints: Grace to you and peace from God our Father, and the Lord Jesus Christ.

verses.text: But he answered, “It is written, ‘Man shall not live by bread alone, but by every word that proceeds out of God’s mouth.’”
verses.meaning: Hungry in the desert, Jesus still put God’s word first. You need bread, but you need his voice even more.
verses.kjv: But he answered and said, It is written, Man shall not live by bread alone, but by every word that proceedeth out of the mouth of God.

verses.text: That they may all be one; even as you, Father, are in me, and I in you, that they also may be one in us; that the world may believe that you sent me.
verses.meaning: Jesus prayed his followers would be one. When Christians love each other, the world sees Jesus.
verses.kjv: That they all may be one; as thou, Father, art in me, and I in thee, that they also may be one in us: that the world may believe that thou hast sent me.

verses.text: As they said these things, Jesus himself stood among them, and said to them, “Peace be to you.”
verses.meaning: His friends were still trying to make sense of the empty tomb when the risen Jesus stood there with peace.
verses.kjv: And as they thus spake, Jesus himself stood in the midst of them, and saith unto them, Peace be unto you.

verses.text: Seek the LORD and his strength. Seek his face forever more.
verses.meaning: Don’t only look for God in a crisis. Keep seeking him and the strength he gives, every day of your life.
verses.kjv: Seek the LORD, and his strength: seek his face evermore.

verses.text: Therefore don’t be anxious, saying, ‘What will we eat?’, ‘What will we drink?’ or, ‘With what will we be clothed?’ For the Gentiles seek after all these things; for your heavenly Father knows that you need all these things.
verses.meaning: Your Father already knows what you need, down to food and clothes. You don’t carry that alone.
verses.kjv: Therefore take no thought, saying, What shall we eat? or, What shall we drink? or, Wherewithal shall we be clothed? (For after all these things do the Gentiles seek:) for your heavenly Father knoweth that ye have need of all these things.

verses.text: But about midnight Paul and Silas were praying and singing hymns to God, and the prisoners were listening to them.
verses.meaning: Beaten and locked up, Paul and Silas sang to God at midnight. Praise in the dark speaks louder than you think.
verses.kjv: And at midnight Paul and Silas prayed, and sang praises unto God: and the prisoners heard them.

verses.text: If I speak with the languages of men and of angels, but don’t have love, I have become sounding brass or a clanging cymbal.
verses.meaning: Impressive words without love are just noise. What gives your voice weight is how much you love.
verses.kjv: Though I speak with the tongues of men and of angels, and have not charity, I am become as sounding brass, or a tinkling cymbal.

verses.text: Jesus said to them, “My food is to do the will of him who sent me and to accomplish his work.”
verses.meaning: Doing what the Father wanted filled Jesus more than a meal. God’s will can be what keeps you going too.
verses.kjv: Jesus saith unto them, My meat is to do the will of him that sent me, and to finish his work.

verses.text: One of his disciples, whom Jesus loved, was at the table, leaning against Jesus’ chest.
verses.meaning: At the Last Supper, one disciple leaned back against Jesus. You’re welcome that close to him.
verses.kjv: Now there was leaning on Jesus’ bosom one of his disciples, whom Jesus loved.

verses.text: But now Christ has been raised from the dead. He became the first fruit of those who are asleep.
verses.meaning: Jesus really rose, the first of many. His resurrection is a preview of what’s coming for his people.
verses.kjv: But now is Christ risen from the dead, and become the firstfruits of them that slept.

verses.text: Zacchaeus stood and said to the Lord, “Behold, Lord, half of my goods I give to the poor. If I have wrongfully exacted anything of anyone, I restore four times as much.” Jesus said to him, “Today, salvation has come to this house, because he also is a son of Abraham.”
verses.meaning: Welcomed by Jesus, Zacchaeus the cheat chose to repay everyone he’d wronged. Grace changes how you live.
verses.kjv: And Zacchæus stood, and said unto the Lord; Behold, Lord, the half of my goods I give to the poor; and if I have taken any thing from any man by false accusation, I restore him fourfold. And Jesus said unto him, This day is salvation come to this house, forsomuch as he also is a son of Abraham.

verses.text: Don’t be afraid of the things which you are about to suffer. Behold, the devil is about to throw some of you into prison, that you may be tested; and you will have oppression for ten days. Be faithful to death, and I will give you the crown of life.
verses.meaning: Jesus didn’t promise his people an easy road. He promised a crown of life to those who stay faithful.
verses.kjv: Fear none of those things which thou shalt suffer: behold, the devil shall cast some of you into prison, that ye may be tried; and ye shall have tribulation ten days: be thou faithful unto death, and I will give thee a crown of life.

verses.text: Now therefore this is what the LORD of Armies says: ‘Consider your ways.’
verses.meaning: God’s word to busy people: think it through. Take an honest look at where your time and effort are going.
verses.kjv: Now therefore thus saith the LORD of hosts; Consider your ways.

verses.text: Thus consider yourselves also to be dead to sin, but alive to God in Christ Jesus our Lord.
verses.meaning: Your old life of sin is dead and done. Start seeing yourself as fully alive to God through Jesus.
verses.kjv: Likewise reckon ye also yourselves to be dead indeed unto sin, but alive unto God through Jesus Christ our Lord.

verses.text: They all ate and were filled. They took up twelve baskets full of that which remained left over from the broken pieces.
verses.meaning: When Jesus fed the crowd, nobody went home hungry, and there were even baskets of leftovers.
verses.kjv: And they did all eat, and were filled: and they took up of the fragments that remained twelve baskets full.

verses.text: Therefore when Jesus saw his mother, and the disciple whom he loved standing there, he said to his mother, “Woman, behold, your son!” Then he said to the disciple, “Behold, your mother!” From that hour, the disciple took her to his own home.
verses.meaning: Even dying on the cross, Jesus made sure his mother would be cared for, giving her a new family.
verses.kjv: When Jesus therefore saw his mother, and the disciple standing by, whom he loved, he saith unto his mother, Woman, behold thy son! Then saith he to the disciple, Behold thy mother! And from that hour that disciple took her unto his own home.

verses.text: After eight days, again his disciples were inside and Thomas was with them. Jesus came, the doors being locked, and stood in the middle, and said, “Peace be to you.”
verses.meaning: Jesus came back through locked doors for doubting Thomas, and his first word was peace.
verses.kjv: And after eight days again his disciples were within, and Thomas with them: then came Jesus, the doors being shut, and stood in the midst, and said, Peace be unto you.

verses.text: The LORD is my strength and song. He has become my salvation.
verses.meaning: When God brings you through, he isn’t just your strength for the fight. He becomes the song you sing after.
verses.kjv: The LORD is my strength and song, and is become my salvation.

verses.text: Then Jesus said to them, “My soul is exceedingly sorrowful, even to death. Stay here and watch with me.”
verses.meaning: Jesus felt crushing dread the night before the cross and asked his friends to stay near. He understands.
verses.kjv: Then saith he unto them, My soul is exceeding sorrowful, even unto death: tarry ye here, and watch with me.

verses.text: From there the brothers, when they heard of us, came to meet us as far as The Market of Appius and The Three Taverns. When Paul saw them, he thanked God and took courage.
verses.meaning: Worn out and headed to Rome as a prisoner, Paul saw friends coming to meet him. He thanked God and took heart.
verses.kjv: And from thence, when the brethren heard of us, they came to meet us as far as Appii forum, and The three taverns: whom when Paul saw, he thanked God, and took courage.

verses.text: If I give away all my goods to feed the poor, and if I give my body to be burned, but don’t have love, it profits me nothing.
verses.meaning: Even huge sacrifices and generous giving add up to nothing if love isn’t what’s behind them.
verses.kjv: And though I bestow all my goods to feed the poor, and though I give my body to be burned, and have not charity, it profiteth me nothing.

verses.text: Don’t work for the food which perishes, but for the food which remains to eternal life, which the Son of Man will give to you. For God the Father has sealed him.
verses.meaning: Don’t burn your life chasing what spoils. Jesus offers what lasts forever, so give your best effort there.
verses.kjv: Labour not for the meat which perisheth, but for that meat which endureth unto everlasting life, which the Son of man shall give unto you: for him hath God the Father sealed.

verses.text: The same night when Herod was about to bring him out, Peter was sleeping between two soldiers, bound with two chains. Guards in front of the door kept the prison.
verses.meaning: The night before his trial, Peter slept chained between guards. Trusting God can let you rest anywhere.
verses.kjv: And when Herod would have brought him forth, the same night Peter was sleeping between two soldiers, bound with two chains: and the keepers before the door kept the prison.

verses.text: For now we see in a mirror, dimly, but then face to face. Now I know in part, but then I will know fully, even as I was also fully known.
verses.meaning: Right now life is blurry and you only see part of it. One day you’ll see God face to face and understand.
verses.kjv: For now we see through a glass, darkly; but then face to face: now I know in part; but then shall I know even as also I am known.

verses.text: Jesus said, “Father, forgive them, for they don’t know what they are doing.” Dividing his garments among them, they cast lots.
verses.meaning: Nailed to a cross, Jesus prayed for the people putting him there. That’s how far his forgiveness goes.
verses.kjv: Then said Jesus, Father, forgive them; for they know not what they do. And they parted his raiment, and cast lots.

verses.text: But having suffered before and been shamefully treated, as you know, at Philippi, we grew bold in our God to tell you the Good News of God in much conflict.
verses.meaning: After being mistreated in Philippi, Paul still found boldness in God to keep sharing the good news.
verses.kjv: But even after that we had suffered before, and were shamefully entreated, as ye know, at Philippi, we were bold in our God to speak unto you the gospel of God with much contention.

verses.text: For where your treasure is, there your heart will be also.
verses.meaning: Your heart follows what you value most. Look at where your time goes and you’ll see what you treasure.
verses.kjv: For where your treasure is, there will your heart be also.

verses.text: The Spirit himself testifies with our spirit that we are children of God; and if children, then heirs—heirs of God and joint heirs with Christ, if indeed we suffer with him, that we may also be glorified with him.
verses.meaning: God’s Spirit quietly confirms it inside you: you’re his child, and you share in all that Jesus inherits.
verses.kjv: The Spirit itself beareth witness with our spirit, that we are the children of God: And if children, then heirs; heirs of God, and joint-heirs with Christ; if so be that we suffer with him, that we may be also glorified together.

verses.text: Jesus summoned his disciples and said, “I have compassion on the multitude, because they have continued with me now three days and have nothing to eat. I don’t want to send them away fasting, or they might faint on the way.”
verses.meaning: Jesus saw the crowd was hungry and didn’t want them fainting on the way home. He cares about your body too.
verses.kjv: Then Jesus called his disciples unto him, and said, I have compassion on the multitude, because they continue with me now three days, and have nothing to eat: and I will not send them away fasting, lest they faint in the way.

verses.text: Day by day, continuing steadfastly with one accord in the temple, and breaking bread at home, they took their food with gladness and singleness of heart, praising God and having favor with all the people. The Lord added to the assembly day by day those who were being saved.
verses.meaning: The first believers met daily, shared meals in homes and praised God with glad hearts. Church is a family.
verses.kjv: And they, continuing daily with one accord in the temple, and breaking bread from house to house, did eat their meat with gladness and singleness of heart, Praising God, and having favour with all the people. And the Lord added to the church daily such as should be saved.

verses.text: So the assemblies throughout all Judea, Galilee, and Samaria had peace and were built up. They were multiplied, walking in the fear of the Lord and in the comfort of the Holy Spirit.
verses.meaning: After a wave of persecution, the early church had a season of peace, growing as people walked with God.
verses.kjv: Then had the churches rest throughout all Judæa and Galilee and Samaria, and were edified; and walking in the fear of the Lord, and in the comfort of the Holy Ghost, were multiplied.

verses.text: Behold, God is my helper. The Lord is the one who sustains my soul.
verses.meaning: People may turn against you, but God is still your helper, the one who keeps your soul going.
verses.kjv: Behold, God is mine helper: the Lord is with them that uphold my soul.

verses.text: But when they deliver you up, don’t be anxious how or what you will say, for it will be given you in that hour what you will say.
verses.meaning: Jesus told followers facing hostile courts not to panic over what to say: the words would come in the moment.
verses.kjv: But when they deliver you up, take no thought how or what ye shall speak: for it shall be given you in that same hour what ye shall speak.

verses.text: I always thank my God concerning you for the grace of God which was given you in Christ Jesus…
verses.meaning: Paul thanked God for a messy church before correcting it. Be grateful for people who aren’t finished yet.
verses.kjv: I thank my God always on your behalf, for the grace of God which is given you by Jesus Christ…

verses.text: Love is patient and is kind. Love doesn’t envy. Love doesn’t brag, is not proud, doesn’t behave itself inappropriately, doesn’t seek its own way, is not provoked, takes no account of evil…
verses.meaning: Real love waits, stays gentle and lets others shine. It isn’t touchy, and it doesn’t store up old hurts.
verses.kjv: Charity suffereth long, and is kind; charity envieth not; charity vaunteth not itself, is not puffed up, Doth not behave itself unseemly, seeketh not her own, is not easily provoked, thinketh no evil…

verses.text: I must work the works of him who sent me while it is day. The night is coming, when no one can work.
verses.meaning: Jesus knew his time was limited and spent it on his Father’s work. Your daylight hours are a gift too.
verses.kjv: I must work the works of him that sent me, while it is day: the night cometh, when no man can work.

verses.text: That I may come to you in joy through the will of God, and together with you, find rest.
verses.meaning: Paul longed to be with friends and rest together. Good company in faith can refill you.
verses.kjv: That I may come unto you with joy by the will of God, and may with you be refreshed.

verses.text: Who delivered us out of so great a death, and does deliver, on whom we have set our hope that he will also still deliver us…
verses.meaning: God rescued Paul before and kept on rescuing him, so Paul kept hoping. Past help fuels future hope.
verses.kjv: Who delivered us from so great a death, and doth deliver: in whom we trust that he will yet deliver us…

verses.text: He said to Jesus, “Lord, remember me when you come into your Kingdom.” Jesus said to him, “Assuredly I tell you, today you will be with me in Paradise.”
verses.meaning: A dying criminal only asked to be remembered. Jesus promised him paradise that very day.
verses.kjv: And he said unto Jesus, Lord, remember me when thou comest into thy kingdom. And Jesus said unto him, Verily I say unto thee, To day shalt thou be with me in paradise.

verses.text: I will not be afraid of tens of thousands of people who have set themselves against me on every side.
verses.meaning: A crowd may be against you on every side, but you don’t have to be afraid when God is the one holding you.
verses.kjv: I will not be afraid of ten thousands of people, that have set themselves against me round about.

verses.text: No one can serve two masters, for either he will hate the one and love the other, or else he will be devoted to one and despise the other. You can’t serve both God and Mammon.
verses.meaning: Only one master can have your full loyalty. Money, or anything else, makes a poor god next to the real one.
verses.kjv: No man can serve two masters: for either he will hate the one, and love the other; or else he will hold to the one, and despise the other. Ye cannot serve God and mammon.

verses.text: Because of him, you are in Christ Jesus, who was made to us wisdom from God, and righteousness and sanctification, and redemption…
verses.meaning: Because of God you’re in Christ, and Jesus has become your wisdom, right standing, holiness and freedom.
verses.kjv: But of him are ye in Christ Jesus, who of God is made unto us wisdom, and righteousness, and sanctification, and redemption…

verses.text: He said to them, “Beware! Keep yourselves from covetousness, for a man’s life doesn’t consist of the abundance of the things which he possesses.”
verses.meaning: Your life is worth far more than what you own. Guard your heart against always wanting more.
verses.kjv: And he said unto them, Take heed, and beware of covetousness: for a man’s life consisteth not in the abundance of the things which he possesseth.

verses.text: The multitude of those who believed were of one heart and soul. Not one of them claimed that anything of the things which he possessed was his own, but they had all things in common.
verses.meaning: The early believers were one in heart and soul, and treated what they owned as something to share.
verses.kjv: And the multitude of them that believed were of one heart and of one soul: neither said any of them that ought of the things which he possessed was his own; but they had all things common.

verses.text: Being therefore justified by faith, we have peace with God through our Lord Jesus Christ…
verses.meaning: Through faith in Jesus, you’re no longer at odds with God. That peace is settled, not earned.
verses.kjv: Therefore being justified by faith, we have peace with God through our Lord Jesus Christ…

verses.text: Yet the righteous will hold to his way. He who has clean hands will grow stronger and stronger.
verses.meaning: In his worst season, Job still believed that people who keep doing right only grow stronger over time.
verses.kjv: The righteous also shall hold on his way, and he that hath clean hands shall be stronger and stronger.

verses.text: He himself was in the stern, asleep on the cushion; and they woke him up and asked him, “Teacher, don’t you care that we are dying?”
verses.meaning: The disciples’ panicked “Don’t you care?” wasn’t a polished prayer. Jesus got up and calmed the storm anyway.
verses.kjv: And he was in the hinder part of the ship, asleep on a pillow: and they awake him, and say unto him, Master, carest thou not that we perish?

verses.text: For who makes you different? And what do you have that you didn’t receive? But if you did receive it, why do you boast as if you had not received it?
verses.meaning: Your talents, chances and blessings were all received. Gratitude leaves no room for bragging.
verses.kjv: For who maketh thee to differ from another? and what hast thou that thou didst not receive? now if thou didst receive it, why dost thou glory, as if thou hadst not received it?

verses.text: Bears all things, believes all things, hopes all things, and endures all things.
verses.meaning: Love doesn’t give up on people. It keeps trusting, keeps hoping and keeps showing up through hard times.
verses.kjv: Beareth all things, believeth all things, hopeth all things, endureth all things.

verses.text: In this my Father is glorified, that you bear much fruit; and so you will be my disciples.
verses.meaning: A life that grows good fruit shows God’s goodness and marks you as Jesus’s follower. Stay connected to him.
verses.kjv: Herein is my Father glorified, that ye bear much fruit; so shall ye be my disciples.

verses.text: For they refreshed my spirit and yours. Therefore acknowledge those who are like that.
verses.meaning: Some people refresh your spirit just by showing up. Notice them and honor them.
verses.kjv: For they have refreshed my spirit and yours: therefore acknowledge ye them that are such.

verses.text: For we know that if the earthly house of our tent is dissolved, we have a building from God, a house not made with hands, eternal, in the heavens.
verses.meaning: Our bodies are like temporary tents. God has a lasting home waiting for his people.
verses.kjv: For we know that if our earthly house of this tabernacle were dissolved, we have a building of God, an house not made with hands, eternal in the heavens.

verses.text: The next day, he saw Jesus coming to him, and said, “Behold, the Lamb of God, who takes away the sin of the world!”
verses.meaning: John pointed at Jesus and named his mission: he came to carry away the sin of the whole world.
verses.kjv: The next day John seeth Jesus coming unto him, and saith, Behold the Lamb of God, which taketh away the sin of the world.

verses.text: Be strong and courageous. Don’t be afraid or dismayed because of the king of Assyria, nor for all the multitude who is with him; for there is a greater one with us than with him.
verses.meaning: Facing an empire’s army, Hezekiah told his people to be brave: the One with them was greater by far.
verses.kjv: Be strong and courageous, be not afraid nor dismayed for the king of Assyria, nor for all the multitude that is with him: for there be more with us than with him…

verses.text: What was sown among the thorns, this is he who hears the word, but the cares of this age and the deceitfulness of riches choke the word, and he becomes unfruitful.
verses.meaning: Jesus warned that worries and the pull of wealth can choke God’s word in you, like weeds crowding a plant.
verses.kjv: He also that received seed among the thorns is he that heareth the word; and the care of this world, and the deceitfulness of riches, choke the word, and he becometh unfruitful.

verses.text: Some of you were such, but you were washed. You were sanctified. You were justified in the name of the Lord Jesus, and in the Spirit of our God.
verses.meaning: Paul listed what some believers used to be, then said: but you were washed. Who you were isn’t who you are.
verses.kjv: And such were some of you: but ye are washed, but ye are sanctified, but ye are justified in the name of the Lord Jesus, and by the Spirit of our God.

verses.text: He said to them, “When I sent you out without purse, bag, and sandals, did you lack anything?” They said, “Nothing.”
verses.meaning: Jesus sent his friends out with almost nothing, then asked what they’d lacked. Their answer: nothing at all.
verses.kjv: And he said unto them, When I sent you without purse, and scrip, and shoes, lacked ye any thing? And they said, Nothing.

verses.text: Peter therefore was kept in the prison, but constant prayer was made by the assembly to God for him.
verses.meaning: While Peter sat in prison, the church kept praying for him. When you can’t do anything else, pray together.
verses.kjv: Peter therefore was kept in prison: but prayer was made without ceasing of the church unto God for him.

verses.text: For God’s Kingdom is not eating and drinking, but righteousness, peace, and joy in the Holy Spirit.
verses.meaning: God’s kingdom isn’t about arguing over food. It’s about doing right, and the peace and joy his Spirit gives.
verses.kjv: For the kingdom of God is not meat and drink; but righteousness, and peace, and joy in the Holy Ghost.

verses.text: She arms her waist with strength, and makes her arms strong.
verses.meaning: The capable woman of Proverbs is strong and ready for hard work. Everyday faithfulness takes real strength.
verses.kjv: She girdeth her loins with strength, and strengtheneth her arms.

verses.text: Aren’t five sparrows sold for two assaria coins? Not one of them is forgotten by God.
verses.meaning: Not even one tiny sparrow slips God’s mind. You aren’t forgotten either.
verses.kjv: Are not five sparrows sold for two farthings, and not one of them is forgotten before God?

verses.text: For this service of giving that you perform not only makes up for lack among the saints, but abounds also through much giving of thanks to God…
verses.meaning: When you help someone in need, you meet a practical need and also set off a wave of thanks to God.
verses.kjv: For the administration of this service not only supplieth the want of the saints, but is abundant also by many thanksgivings unto God…

verses.text: Love never fails. But where there are prophecies, they will be done away with. Where there are various languages, they will cease. Where there is knowledge, it will be done away with.
verses.meaning: Gifts, knowledge and talents will all pass away one day, but love will outlast every one of them.
verses.kjv: Charity never faileth: but whether there be prophecies, they shall fail; whether there be tongues, they shall cease; whether there be knowledge, it shall vanish away.

verses.text: Jesus therefore said to them again, “Peace be to you. As the Father has sent me, even so I send you.”
verses.meaning: The risen Jesus gave peace, then a mission: just as the Father sent him, he sends you into your world.
verses.kjv: Then said Jesus to them again, Peace be unto you: as my Father hath sent me, even so send I you.

verses.text: Let’s therefore give diligence to enter into that rest, lest anyone fall after the same example of disobedience.
verses.meaning: Entering God’s rest takes a kind of effort: keep choosing to trust him instead of turning away.
verses.kjv: Let us labour therefore to enter into that rest, lest any man fall after the same example of unbelief.

verses.text: Having the eyes of your hearts enlightened, that you may know what is the hope of his calling, and what are the riches of the glory of his inheritance in the saints…
verses.meaning: Paul prays you’d truly see the hope God has called you to, and how rich his promises are.
verses.kjv: The eyes of your understanding being enlightened; that ye may know what is the hope of his calling, and what the riches of the glory of his inheritance in the saints…

verses.text: Jesus, standing up, saw her and said, “Woman, where are your accusers? Did no one condemn you?” She said, “No one, Lord.” Jesus said, “Neither do I condemn you. Go your way. From now on, sin no more.”
verses.meaning: Jesus sent her accusers off, refused to condemn her and called her to a new life. Grace first, then change.
verses.kjv: When Jesus had lifted up himself, and saw none but the woman, he said unto her, Woman, where are those thine accusers? hath no man condemned thee? She said, No man, Lord. And Jesus said unto her, Neither do I condemn thee: go, and sin no more.

verses.text: ‘You will not need to fight this battle. Set yourselves, stand still, and see the salvation of the LORD with you, O Judah and Jerusalem. Don’t be afraid, nor be dismayed. Go out against them tomorrow, for the LORD is with you.’
verses.meaning: Sometimes courage means showing up, standing still and letting God do what only he can do.
verses.kjv: Ye shall not need to fight in this battle: set yourselves, stand ye still, and see the salvation of the LORD with you, O Judah and Jerusalem: fear not, nor be dismayed; to morrow go out against them: for the LORD will be with you.

verses.text: But when he saw that the wind was strong, he was afraid, and beginning to sink, he cried out, saying, “Lord, save me!”
verses.meaning: Peter walked on water until he looked at the wind. When fear pulls your eyes away, cry out to Jesus.
verses.kjv: But when he saw the wind boisterous, he was afraid; and beginning to sink, he cried, saying, Lord, save me.

verses.text: But anyone who loves God is known by him.
verses.meaning: Loving God isn’t a one-way street. If you love him, you’re fully known by him.
verses.kjv: But if any man love God, the same is known of him.

verses.text: He answered them, “He who has two coats, let him give to him who has none. He who has food, let him do likewise.”
verses.meaning: Got two coats? Give one away. Got food? Share it. Getting ready for God looks this practical.
verses.kjv: He answereth and saith unto them, He that hath two coats, let him impart to him that hath none; and he that hath meat, let him do likewise.

verses.text: He began to speak boldly in the synagogue. But when Priscilla and Aquila heard him, they took him aside, and explained to him the way of God more accurately.
verses.meaning: Priscilla and Aquila didn’t correct Apollos in public. They took him aside and taught him kindly.
verses.kjv: And he began to speak boldly in the synagogue: whom when Aquila and Priscilla had heard, they took him unto them, and expounded unto him the way of God more perfectly.

verses.text: For God is not a God of confusion but of peace, as in all the assemblies of the saints.
verses.meaning: God isn’t the author of chaos. Where he’s at work, you’ll find order and peace.
verses.kjv: For God is not the author of confusion, but of peace, as in all churches of the saints.

verses.text: “I will strengthen them in the LORD. They will walk up and down in his name,” says the LORD.
verses.meaning: God promises to make his people strong in him, so that wherever they go, they walk in his name.
verses.kjv: And I will strengthen them in the LORD; and they shall walk up and down in his name, saith the LORD.

verses.text: He said to them, “Why are you troubled? Why do doubts arise in your hearts? See my hands and my feet, that it is truly me. Touch me and see, for a spirit doesn’t have flesh and bones, as you see that I have.”
verses.meaning: When fear and doubt filled his friends, the risen Jesus didn’t scold. He invited them to come close and see.
verses.kjv: And he said unto them, Why are ye troubled? and why do thoughts arise in your hearts? Behold my hands and my feet, that it is I myself: handle me, and see; for a spirit hath not flesh and bones, as ye see me have.

verses.text: Blessed be the God and Father of our Lord Jesus Christ, who has blessed us with every spiritual blessing in the heavenly places in Christ…
verses.meaning: In Christ you aren’t missing a single spiritual blessing. Start your praise there, whatever else today holds.
verses.kjv: Blessed be the God and Father of our Lord Jesus Christ, who hath blessed us with all spiritual blessings in heavenly places in Christ…

verses.text: For the love of Christ compels us; because we judge thus: that one died for all, therefore all died.
verses.meaning: Christ died for everyone. Knowing that love is what moves you to live for him, not for yourself.
verses.kjv: For the love of Christ constraineth us; because we thus judge, that if one died for all, then were all dead…

verses.text: For David, after he had in his own generation served the counsel of God, fell asleep, was laid with his fathers, and saw decay.
verses.meaning: David served God’s purposes in his own lifetime. You don’t have to serve every era, just yours.
verses.kjv: For David, after he had served his own generation by the will of God, fell on sleep, and was laid unto his fathers, and saw corruption…

verses.text: They will never be hungry or thirsty any more. The sun won’t beat on them, nor any heat; for the Lamb who is in the middle of the throne shepherds them and leads them to springs of life-giving waters. And God will wipe away every tear from their eyes.
verses.meaning: One day Jesus will shepherd his people to living water, with no more hunger, scorching heat or tears.
verses.kjv: They shall hunger no more, neither thirst any more; neither shall the sun light on them, nor any heat. For the Lamb which is in the midst of the throne shall feed them, and shall lead them unto living fountains of waters: and God shall wipe away all tears from their eyes.

verses.text: To whom God was pleased to make known what are the riches of the glory of this mystery among the Gentiles, which is Christ in you, the hope of glory.
verses.meaning: God’s once hidden plan is out: Christ living in you, the promise of a glorious future.
verses.kjv: To whom God would make known what is the riches of the glory of this mystery among the Gentiles; which is Christ in you, the hope of glory…

verses.text: All the prophets testify about him, that through his name everyone who believes in him will receive remission of sins.
verses.meaning: Every prophet pointed ahead to Jesus: anyone who trusts him is forgiven through his name.
verses.kjv: To him give all the prophets witness, that through his name whosoever believeth in him shall receive remission of sins.

verses.text: I will also speak of your statutes before kings, and will not be disappointed.
verses.meaning: You don’t have to be embarrassed to talk about God’s ways, even in front of powerful people.
verses.kjv: I will speak of thy testimonies also before kings, and will not be ashamed.

verses.text: He said to them, “Take heed what you hear. With whatever measure you measure, it will be measured to you; and more will be given to you who hear.”
verses.meaning: Pay attention to what you let into your ears. Give God’s truth your attention and you’ll receive even more.
verses.kjv: And he said unto them, Take heed what ye hear: with what measure ye mete, it shall be measured to you: and unto you that hear shall more be given.

verses.text: For him who knew no sin he made to be sin on our behalf, so that in him we might become the righteousness of God.
verses.meaning: Jesus took your sin so you could take his goodness. In him, God sees you as right and whole.
verses.kjv: For he hath made him to be sin for us, who knew no sin; that we might be made the righteousness of God in him.

verses.text: Simon answered him, “Master, we worked all night and caught nothing; but at your word I will let down the net.” When they had done this, they caught a great multitude of fish, and their net was breaking.
verses.meaning: After a long night of empty nets, Peter tried again simply because Jesus said so. Trust him when you’re tired.
verses.kjv: And Simon answering said unto him, Master, we have toiled all the night, and have taken nothing: nevertheless at thy word I will let down the net. And when they had this done, they inclosed a great multitude of fishes: and their net brake.

verses.text: The natives showed us uncommon kindness; for they kindled a fire and received us all, because of the present rain and because of the cold.
verses.meaning: Shipwrecked, soaked and cold, Paul’s crew met strangers who lit a fire and welcomed them all.
verses.kjv: And the barbarous people shewed us no little kindness: for they kindled a fire, and received us every one, because of the present rain, and because of the cold.

verses.text: But all things are of God, who reconciled us to himself through Jesus Christ, and gave to us the ministry of reconciliation…
verses.meaning: God made peace with you through Jesus, then handed you the job of helping others find it too.
verses.kjv: And all things are of God, who hath reconciled us to himself by Jesus Christ, and hath given to us the ministry of reconciliation…

verses.text: Ah Lord GOD! Behold, you have made the heavens and the earth by your great power and by your outstretched arm. There is nothing too hard for you.
verses.meaning: The God who made the heavens and the earth has power to spare. Nothing you face is beyond him.
verses.kjv: Ah Lord GOD! behold, thou hast made the heaven and the earth by thy great power and stretched out arm, and there is nothing too hard for thee…

verses.text: I will pray to the Father, and he will give you another Counselor, that he may be with you forever…
verses.meaning: Jesus promised a Helper who would stay with his followers forever. You’re never left on your own.
verses.kjv: And I will pray the Father, and he shall give you another Comforter, that he may abide with you for ever…

verses.text: Giving thanks always concerning all things in the name of our Lord Jesus Christ to God, even the Father…
verses.meaning: Thanks isn’t only for good days. In Jesus’s name, look for something to thank the Father for in everything.
verses.kjv: Giving thanks always for all things unto God and the Father in the name of our Lord Jesus Christ…

verses.text: For in Christ Jesus neither circumcision nor uncircumcision amounts to anything, but faith working through love.
verses.meaning: Religious labels don’t count for much with God. What matters is faith that shows itself in love.
verses.kjv: For in Jesus Christ neither circumcision availeth any thing, nor uncircumcision; but faith which worketh by love.

verses.text: That they should seek the Lord, if perhaps they might reach out for him and find him, though he is not far from each one of us.
verses.meaning: God set up our lives so we would look for him, and he isn’t hard to find. He’s close to each of us.
verses.kjv: That they should seek the Lord, if haply they might feel after him, and find him, though he be not far from every one of us…

verses.text: I heard a voice from heaven saying, “Write, ‘Blessed are the dead who die in the Lord from now on.’” “Yes,” says the Spirit, “that they may rest from their labors, for their works follow with them.”
verses.meaning: For those who die in the Lord, the long work is over. They rest, and what they did in love lasts.
verses.kjv: And I heard a voice from heaven saying unto me, Write, Blessed are the dead which die in the Lord from henceforth: Yea, saith the Spirit, that they may rest from their labours; and their works do follow them.

verses.text: But we don’t want you to be ignorant, brothers, concerning those who have fallen asleep, so that you don’t grieve like the rest, who have no hope. For if we believe that Jesus died and rose again, even so God will bring with him those who have fallen asleep in Jesus.
verses.meaning: Grief is real, but for those who belong to Jesus it isn’t hopeless. He rose, and he’ll bring them back.
verses.kjv: But I would not have you to be ignorant, brethren, concerning them which are asleep, that ye sorrow not, even as others which have no hope. For if we believe that Jesus died and rose again, even so them also which sleep in Jesus will God bring with him.

verses.text: For all have sinned, and fall short of the glory of God; being justified freely by his grace through the redemption that is in Christ Jesus…
verses.meaning: Everyone falls short, no exceptions. And anyone can be made right with God as a free gift through Jesus.
verses.kjv: For all have sinned, and come short of the glory of God; Being justified freely by his grace through the redemption that is in Christ Jesus…

verses.text: You who tell good news to Zion, go up on a high mountain. You who tell good news to Jerusalem, lift up your voice with strength! Lift it up! Don’t be afraid! Say to the cities of Judah, “Behold, your God!”
