verses.meaning: Good news isn’t meant to be whispered. Raise your voice without fear and point people to God.
verses.kjv: O Zion, that bringest good tidings, get thee up into the high mountain; O Jerusalem, that bringest good tidings, lift up thy voice with strength; lift it up, be not afraid; say unto the cities of Judah, Behold your God!

verses.text: But Jesus said to him, “No one, having put his hand to the plow and looking back, is fit for God’s Kingdom.”
verses.meaning: A farmer looking backward ruins the row. Following Jesus means facing forward, not over your shoulder.
verses.kjv: And Jesus said unto him, No man, having put his hand to the plough, and looking back, is fit for the kingdom of God.

verses.text: ‘I will be to you a Father. You will be to me sons and daughters,’ says the Lord Almighty.
verses.meaning: The Lord Almighty wants to be your Father, and he calls you his son or his daughter.
verses.kjv: And will be a Father unto you, and ye shall be my sons and daughters, saith the Lord Almighty.

verses.text: “There is a boy here who has five barley loaves and two fish, but what are these among so many?”
verses.meaning: One boy’s lunch looked useless next to a hungry crowd. Jesus can start with whatever little you bring him.
verses.kjv: There is a lad here, which hath five barley loaves, and two small fishes: but what are they among so many?

verses.text: For I long to see you, that I may impart to you some spiritual gift, to the end that you may be established; that is, that I with you may be encouraged in you, each of us by the other’s faith, both yours and mine.
verses.meaning: Faith grows when believers meet: you encourage others, and their faith encourages you right back.
verses.kjv: For I long to see you, that I may impart unto you some spiritual gift, to the end ye may be established; That is, that I may be comforted together with you by the mutual faith both of you and me.

verses.text: For he is our peace, who made both one, and broke down the middle wall of separation…
verses.meaning: Jesus is our peace: he tears down the walls that divide people from God and from each other.
verses.kjv: For he is our peace, who hath made both one, and hath broken down the middle wall of partition between us…

verses.text: The bows of the mighty men are broken. Those who stumbled are armed with strength.
verses.meaning: Hannah sang about God turning things upside down: the proud and mighty fall, and the stumbling get strength.
verses.kjv: The bows of the mighty men are broken, and they that stumbled are girded with strength.

verses.text: My Father who has given them to me is greater than all. No one is able to snatch them out of my Father’s hand.
verses.meaning: You’re held in the Father’s hand, and nothing is strong enough to pull you out of it.
verses.kjv: My Father, which gave them me, is greater than all; and no man is able to pluck them out of my Father’s hand.

verses.text: I thank my God whenever I remember you…
verses.meaning: Think of someone who shaped your faith. Paul turned memories like that straight into prayers of thanks.
verses.kjv: I thank my God upon every remembrance of you…

verses.text: But God, being rich in mercy, for his great love with which he loved us, even when we were dead through our trespasses, made us alive together with Christ—by grace you have been saved—
verses.meaning: God didn’t wait for you to get it together. His great love brought you to life when you were far gone.
verses.kjv: But God, who is rich in mercy, for his great love wherewith he loved us, Even when we were dead in sins, hath quickened us together with Christ, (by grace ye are saved;)

verses.text: For we are God’s fellow workers. You are God’s farming, God’s building.
verses.meaning: Paul called himself God’s coworker and the church God’s field. Your work counts, but the project is his.
verses.kjv: For we are labourers together with God: ye are God’s husbandry, ye are God’s building.

verses.text: Therefore my heart is glad, and my tongue rejoices. My body shall also dwell in safety.
verses.meaning: When you trust God with your life, your heart can be glad and even your body can rest secure.
verses.kjv: Therefore my heart is glad, and my glory rejoiceth: my flesh also shall rest in hope.

verses.text: Looking for the blessed hope and appearing of the glory of our great God and Savior, Jesus Christ…
verses.meaning: Christians live looking forward to one bright day: the day Jesus appears in all his glory.
verses.kjv: Looking for that blessed hope, and the glorious appearing of the great God and our Saviour Jesus Christ…

verses.text: For if while we were enemies, we were reconciled to God through the death of his Son, much more, being reconciled, we will be saved by his life.
verses.meaning: God made peace with you when you were still his enemy. How much more will the living Jesus save you now?
verses.kjv: For if, when we were enemies, we were reconciled to God by the death of his Son, much more, being reconciled, we shall be saved by his life.

verses.text: He commissioned Joshua the son of Nun, and said, “Be strong and courageous; for you shall bring the children of Israel into the land which I swore to them. I will be with you.”
verses.meaning: As Joshua took over from Moses, God gave him one charge and one promise: be brave, because I will be with you.
verses.kjv: And he gave Joshua the son of Nun a charge, and said, Be strong and of a good courage: for thou shalt bring the children of Israel into the land which I sware unto them: and I will be with thee.

verses.text: So be careful, or your hearts will be loaded down with carousing, drunkenness, and cares of this life, and that day will come on you suddenly.
verses.meaning: Jesus warned that worry and indulgence can weigh your heart down until you’re caught off guard. Stay alert.
verses.kjv: And take heed to yourselves, lest at any time your hearts be overcharged with surfeiting, and drunkenness, and cares of this life, and so that day come upon you unawares.

verses.text: If you are Christ’s, then you are Abraham’s offspring and heirs according to promise.
verses.meaning: If you belong to Christ, you’re part of Abraham’s family and an heir to God’s promise.
verses.kjv: And if ye be Christ’s, then are ye Abraham’s seed, and heirs according to the promise.

verses.text: Yet he didn’t leave himself without witness, in that he did good and gave you rains from the sky and fruitful seasons, filling our hearts with food and gladness.
verses.meaning: Rain, harvests and meals that make you glad all point to a kind God who never stopped caring for people.
verses.kjv: Nevertheless he left not himself without witness, in that he did good, and gave us rain from heaven, and fruitful seasons, filling our hearts with food and gladness.

verses.text: For even as we have many members in one body, and all the members don’t have the same function, so we, who are many, are one body in Christ, and individually members of one another…
verses.meaning: Every believer has a different role, but you belong to one body and you belong to each other.
verses.kjv: For as we have many members in one body, and all members have not the same office: So we, being many, are one body in Christ, and every one members one of another.

verses.text: He came and preached peace to you who were far off and to those who were near.
verses.meaning: Whether you grew up in church or feel like an outsider, Jesus came announcing peace for you.
verses.kjv: And came and preached peace to you which were afar off, and to them that were nigh.

verses.text: For you have been a stronghold to the poor, a stronghold to the needy in his distress, a refuge from the storm, a shade from the heat, when the blast of the dreaded ones is like a storm against the wall.
verses.meaning: For people who are poor or overwhelmed, God is a strong shelter: shade from the heat and cover from the storm.
verses.kjv: For thou hast been a strength to the poor, a strength to the needy in his distress, a refuge from the storm, a shadow from the heat, when the blast of the terrible ones is as a storm against the wall.

verses.text: All those whom the Father gives me will come to me. He who comes to me I will in no way throw out.
verses.meaning: Jesus won’t turn away anyone who comes to him. You don’t have to fear being rejected.
verses.kjv: All that the Father giveth me shall come to me; and him that cometh to me I will in no wise cast out.

verses.text: Giving thanks to the Father, who made us fit to be partakers of the inheritance of the saints in light…
verses.meaning: You didn’t earn your place among God’s people. The Father made you fit for it, and that deserves your thanks.
verses.kjv: Giving thanks unto the Father, which hath made us meet to be partakers of the inheritance of the saints in light…

verses.text: May be strengthened to comprehend with all the saints what is the width and length and height and depth, and to know Christ’s love which surpasses knowledge, that you may be filled with all the fullness of God.
verses.meaning: Christ’s love is bigger than you can measure in any direction. Ask God to help you grasp more of it.
verses.kjv: May be able to comprehend with all saints what is the breadth, and length, and depth, and height; And to know the love of Christ, which passeth knowledge, that ye might be filled with all the fulness of God.

verses.text: But now God has set the members, each one of them, in the body, just as he desired.
verses.meaning: Your place in the church isn’t random. God put each person where he wanted them, you included.
verses.kjv: But now hath God set the members every one of them in the body, as it hath pleased him.

verses.text: I will dwell in your tent forever. I will take refuge in the shelter of your wings. Selah.
verses.meaning: David longed to live in God’s tent and shelter under his wings. You can make your home with God too.
verses.kjv: I will abide in thy tabernacle for ever: I will trust in the covert of thy wings. Selah.

verses.text: This hope we have as an anchor of the soul, a hope both sure and steadfast and entering into that which is within the veil…
verses.meaning: Hope in God works like an anchor, holding your soul steady when the waves get rough.
verses.kjv: Which hope we have as an anchor of the soul, both sure and stedfast, and which entereth into that within the veil…

verses.text: The law came in that the trespass might abound; but where sin abounded, grace abounded more exceedingly…
verses.meaning: However big the sin, God’s grace is bigger. It always outruns the mess you’ve made.
verses.kjv: Moreover the law entered, that the offence might abound. But where sin abounded, grace did much more abound…

verses.text: If I say that I will not make mention of him, or speak any more in his name, then there is in my heart as it were a burning fire shut up in my bones. I am weary with holding it in. I can’t.
verses.meaning: Jeremiah tried to stay silent, but God’s word burned inside him like fire. Some truths need to be spoken.
verses.kjv: Then I said, I will not make mention of him, nor speak any more in his name. But his word was in mine heart as a burning fire shut up in my bones, and I was weary with forbearing, and I could not stay.

verses.text: But we will continue steadfastly in prayer and in the ministry of the word.
verses.meaning: The apostles guarded their main work: prayer and the word. Saying no to good things can protect the best.
verses.kjv: But we will give ourselves continually to prayer, and to the ministry of the word.

verses.text: And because you are children, God sent out the Spirit of his Son into your hearts, crying, “Abba, Father!” So you are no longer a bondservant, but a son; and if a son, then an heir of God through Christ.
verses.meaning: Jesus’s Spirit in you calls God Father. You’re not a servant earning your keep; you’re his child and heir.
verses.kjv: And because ye are sons, God hath sent forth the Spirit of his Son into your hearts, crying, Abba, Father. Wherefore thou art no more a servant, but a son; and if a son, then an heir of God through Christ.

verses.text: He isn’t served by men’s hands, as though he needed anything, seeing he himself gives to all life and breath and all things.
verses.meaning: God doesn’t need anything from you. He’s the one giving you every breath and everything else.
verses.kjv: Neither is worshipped with men’s hands, as though he needed any thing, seeing he giveth to all life, and breath, and all things…

verses.text: In love of the brothers be tenderly affectionate to one another; in honor prefer one another…
verses.meaning: Love fellow believers warmly, like family, and be the first to give honor instead of seeking it.
verses.kjv: Be kindly affectioned one to another with brotherly love; in honour preferring one another…

verses.text: Being eager to keep the unity of the Spirit in the bond of peace.
verses.meaning: Unity doesn’t keep itself. Put real effort into staying at peace with other believers.
verses.kjv: Endeavouring to keep the unity of the Spirit in the bond of peace.

verses.text: My speech and my preaching were not in persuasive words of human wisdom, but in demonstration of the Spirit and of power, that your faith wouldn’t stand in the wisdom of men, but in the power of God.
verses.meaning: Paul skipped the slick speeches, so people’s faith would rest on God’s power, not on human cleverness.
verses.kjv: And my speech and my preaching was not with enticing words of man’s wisdom, but in demonstration of the Spirit and of power: That your faith should not stand in the wisdom of men, but in the power of God.

verses.text: I pray not that you would take them from the world, but that you would keep them from the evil one.
verses.meaning: Jesus prayed for his followers to be kept safe from evil while they kept living in the real world.
verses.kjv: I pray not that thou shouldest take them out of the world, but that thou shouldest keep them from the evil.

verses.text: Continue steadfastly in prayer, watching in it with thanksgiving…
verses.meaning: Keep praying, stay alert, and keep thanking. Gratitude keeps your prayers from turning into a complaint list.
verses.kjv: Continue in prayer, and watch in the same with thanksgiving…

verses.text: But speaking truth in love, we may grow up in all things into him who is the head, Christ…
verses.meaning: Honesty and love belong together. Telling the truth kindly helps everyone grow more like Jesus.
verses.kjv: But speaking the truth in love, may grow up into him in all things, which is the head, even Christ…

verses.text: Therefore also we make it our aim, whether at home or absent, to be well pleasing to him.
verses.meaning: Wherever life takes you, the real goal is pleasing God. That one aim simplifies a lot of choices.
verses.kjv: Wherefore we labour, that, whether present or absent, we may be accepted of him.

verses.text: The day is yours, the night is also yours. You have prepared the light and the sun.
verses.meaning: Day and night both belong to God. You can hand him the dark hours instead of holding them alone.
verses.kjv: The day is thine, the night also is thine: thou hast prepared the light and the sun.

verses.text: Let’s hold fast the confession of our hope without wavering; for he who promised is faithful.
verses.meaning: Keep holding on to hope without letting go. The one who made the promise can be trusted.
verses.kjv: Let us hold fast the profession of our faith without wavering; (for he is faithful that promised;)

verses.text: Don’t seek revenge yourselves, beloved, but give place to God’s wrath. For it is written, “Vengeance belongs to me; I will repay, says the Lord.”
verses.meaning: You don’t have to get revenge. Leave justice in God’s hands: he sees everything and will set it right.
verses.kjv: Dearly beloved, avenge not yourselves, but rather give place unto wrath: for it is written, Vengeance is mine; I will repay, saith the Lord.

verses.text: In that day, it will be said to Jerusalem, “Don’t be afraid, Zion. Don’t let your hands be weak.”
verses.meaning: God tells his people not to be afraid or let their hands go limp, because he is right there with them.
verses.kjv: In that day it shall be said to Jerusalem, Fear thou not: and to Zion, Let not thine hands be slack.

verses.text: Now these were more noble than those in Thessalonica, in that they received the word with all readiness of mind, examining the Scriptures daily to see whether these things were so.
verses.meaning: The Bereans listened eagerly, then checked the Scriptures daily. Test what you hear, even from a good speaker.
verses.kjv: These were more noble than those in Thessalonica, in that they received the word with all readiness of mind, and searched the scriptures daily, whether those things were so.

verses.text: Even as he chose us in him before the foundation of the world, that we would be holy and without defect before him in love…
verses.meaning: Before the world began, God chose you to stand before him holy, wrapped in his love.
verses.kjv: According as he hath chosen us in him before the foundation of the world, that we should be holy and without blame before him in love…

verses.text: In all things I gave you an example, that so laboring you ought to help the weak, and to remember the words of the Lord Jesus, that he himself said, ‘It is more blessed to give than to receive.’
verses.meaning: Jesus said giving brings more blessing than receiving. Helping the weak is how you find that out for yourself.
verses.kjv: I have shewed you all things, how that so labouring ye ought to support the weak, and to remember the words of the Lord Jesus, how he said, It is more blessed to give than to receive.

verses.text: The eye can’t tell the hand, “I have no need for you,” or again the head to the feet, “I have no need for you.”
verses.meaning: No one in the church gets to say “I don’t need you.” Every person and every gift has a place.
verses.kjv: And the eye cannot say unto the hand, I have no need of thee: nor again the head to the feet, I have no need of you.

verses.text: Do the things which you learned, received, heard, and saw in me, and the God of peace will be with you.
verses.meaning: Put what you’ve learned into practice, and the God of peace will be right there with you.
verses.kjv: Those things, which ye have both learned, and received, and heard, and seen in me, do: and the God of peace shall be with you.

verses.text: Because the foolishness of God is wiser than men, and the weakness of God is stronger than men.
verses.meaning: Even what looks weak or foolish about God is stronger and wiser than the best that people can offer.
verses.kjv: Because the foolishness of God is wiser than men; and the weakness of God is stronger than men.

verses.text: Who is he who condemns? It is Christ who died, yes rather, who was raised from the dead, who is at the right hand of God, who also makes intercession for us.
verses.meaning: When guilt piles on, remember who’s on your side: the risen Jesus speaks up for you, not against you.
verses.kjv: Who is he that condemneth? It is Christ that died, yea rather, that is risen again, who is even at the right hand of God, who also maketh intercession for us.

verses.text: For what thanksgiving can we give again to God for you, for all the joy with which we rejoice for your sakes before our God…
verses.meaning: Paul couldn’t find enough ways to thank God for the joy his friends gave him. Who brings you that kind of joy?
verses.kjv: For what thanks can we render to God again for you, for all the joy wherewith we joy for your sakes before our God…

verses.text: Grace be with all those who love our Lord Jesus Christ with incorruptible love. Amen.
verses.meaning: Paul’s parting blessing: grace to everyone who loves Jesus with a love that never fades.
verses.kjv: Grace be with all them that love our Lord Jesus Christ in sincerity. Amen.

verses.text: He died for all, that those who live should no longer live to themselves, but to him who for their sakes died and rose again.
verses.meaning: Jesus died so you could stop living just for yourself. Life gets bigger when it’s lived for him.
verses.kjv: And that he died for all, that they which live should not henceforth live unto themselves, but unto him which died for them, and rose again.

verses.text: The sun rises, and they steal away, and lie down in their dens. Man goes out to his work, to his labor until the evening.
verses.meaning: God built a rhythm into creation: work starts in the morning and ends at evening. Yours can stop too.
verses.kjv: The sun ariseth, they gather themselves together, and lay them down in their dens. Man goeth forth unto his work and to his labour until the evening.

verses.text: Therefore he is also able to save to the uttermost those who draw near to God through him, seeing that he lives forever to make intercession for them.
verses.meaning: Jesus is alive and always speaking to God for you. He can save completely, from start to finish.
verses.kjv: Wherefore he is able also to save them to the uttermost that come unto God by him, seeing he ever liveth to make intercession for them.

verses.text: Don’t be overcome by evil, but overcome evil with good.
verses.meaning: Evil doesn’t get the last move in your life. You can answer it with good instead of more of the same.
verses.kjv: Be not overcome of evil, but overcome evil with good.

verses.text: What I tell you in the darkness, speak in the light; and what you hear whispered in the ear, proclaim on the housetops.
verses.meaning: What Jesus teaches you in quiet moments isn’t meant to stay hidden. Share it out loud.
verses.kjv: What I tell you in darkness, that speak ye in light: and what ye hear in the ear, that preach ye upon the housetops.

verses.text: But put on the Lord Jesus Christ, and make no provision for the flesh, for its lusts.
verses.meaning: Clothe yourself with Jesus, and don’t plan ways to feed your cravings. Remove the easy access.
verses.kjv: But put ye on the Lord Jesus Christ, and make not provision for the flesh, to fulfil the lusts thereof.

verses.text: In him you also, having heard the word of the truth, the Good News of your salvation—in whom, having also believed, you were sealed with the promised Holy Spirit…
verses.meaning: When you believed, God marked you as his own with his Holy Spirit, like a seal on something precious.
verses.kjv: In whom ye also trusted, after that ye heard the word of truth, the gospel of your salvation: in whom also after that ye believed, ye were sealed with that holy Spirit of promise…

verses.text: Let each man give according as he has determined in his heart, not grudgingly or under compulsion, for God loves a cheerful giver.
verses.meaning: Give from a willing heart, not guilt or pressure. God delights in a person who enjoys being generous.
verses.kjv: Every man according as he purposeth in his heart, so let him give; not grudgingly, or of necessity: for God loveth a cheerful giver.

verses.text: That there should be no division in the body, but that the members should have the same care for one another.
verses.meaning: God designed his church with no divisions, so that everyone cares for each other equally.
verses.kjv: That there should be no schism in the body; but that the members should have the same care one for another.

verses.text: And through him to reconcile all things to himself by him, whether things on the earth or things in the heavens, having made peace through the blood of his cross.
verses.meaning: Through the cross, Jesus is making peace with everything that’s broken, in heaven and on earth.
verses.kjv: And, having made peace through the blood of his cross, by him to reconcile all things unto himself; by him, I say, whether they be things in earth, or things in heaven.

verses.text: Therefore, seeing we have this ministry, even as we obtained mercy, we don’t faint.
verses.meaning: Remembering the mercy you’ve been shown gives you a reason not to give up, even when the work is hard.
verses.kjv: Therefore seeing we have this ministry, as we have received mercy, we faint not…

verses.text: For we don’t desire to have you uninformed, brothers, concerning our affliction which happened to us in Asia: that we were weighed down exceedingly, beyond our power, so much that we despaired even of life.
verses.meaning: Paul once felt crushed beyond his strength, even to despair. God carried him through, and he can carry you.
verses.kjv: For we would not, brethren, have you ignorant of our trouble which came to us in Asia, that we were pressed out of measure, above strength, insomuch that we despaired even of life…

verses.text: We are bound to always give thanks to God for you, brothers, even as it is appropriate, because your faith grows exceedingly, and the love of each and every one of you toward one another abounds…
verses.meaning: Notice growth in the people around you, like stronger faith and kinder love, and thank God for it out loud.
verses.kjv: We are bound to thank God always for you, brethren, as it is meet, because that your faith groweth exceedingly, and the charity of every one of you all toward each other aboundeth…

verses.text: Remembering without ceasing your work of faith and labor of love and perseverance of hope in our Lord Jesus Christ, before our God and Father.
verses.meaning: Love isn’t lazy. Paul thanked God for believers whose faith got busy and whose love worked hard.
verses.kjv: Remembering without ceasing your work of faith, and labour of love, and patience of hope in our Lord Jesus Christ, in the sight of God and our Father…

verses.text: We are therefore ambassadors on behalf of Christ, as though God were entreating by us: we beg you on behalf of Christ, be reconciled to God.
verses.meaning: You represent Christ wherever you go. Through you, God is inviting people to come back to him.
verses.kjv: Now then we are ambassadors for Christ, as though God did beseech you by us: we pray you in Christ’s stead, be ye reconciled to God.

verses.text: ‘It is a sign between me and the children of Israel forever; for in six days the LORD made heaven and earth, and on the seventh day he rested, and was refreshed.’
verses.meaning: Even God stopped and was refreshed after creating. Rest isn’t laziness; it’s part of his design.
verses.kjv: It is a sign between me and the children of Israel for ever: for in six days the LORD made heaven and earth, and on the seventh day he rested, and was refreshed.

verses.text: But now they desire a better country, that is, a heavenly one. Therefore God is not ashamed of them, to be called their God, for he has prepared a city for them.
verses.meaning: Like the faithful before you, you can long for a better home. God isn’t ashamed to be your God.
verses.kjv: But now they desire a better country, that is, an heavenly: wherefore God is not ashamed to be called their God: for he hath prepared for them a city.

verses.text: So that, on the contrary, you should rather forgive him and comfort him, lest by any means such a one should be swallowed up with his excessive sorrow. Therefore I beg you to confirm your love toward him.
verses.meaning: When someone has truly turned around, forgive and comfort them. Shame shouldn’t be allowed to swallow them.
verses.kjv: So that contrariwise ye ought rather to forgive him, and comfort him, lest perhaps such a one should be swallowed up with overmuch sorrow. Wherefore I beseech you that ye would confirm your love toward him.

verses.text: Everyone therefore who confesses me before men, I will also confess him before my Father who is in heaven.
verses.meaning: Don’t be shy about belonging to Jesus. When you stand up for him, he stands up for you before the Father.
verses.kjv: Whosoever therefore shall confess me before men, him will I confess also before my Father which is in heaven.

verses.text: This I say for your own benefit, not that I may ensnare you, but for that which is appropriate, and that you may attend to the Lord without distraction.
verses.meaning: Paul wanted believers free to give the Lord undivided attention. That’s a goal worth protecting every day.
verses.kjv: And this I speak for your own profit; not that I may cast a snare upon you, but for that which is comely, and that ye may attend upon the Lord without distraction.

verses.text: But now in Christ Jesus you who once were far off are made near in the blood of Christ.
verses.meaning: You may have felt far from God, but Jesus’s sacrifice has brought you all the way near.
verses.kjv: But now in Christ Jesus ye who sometimes were far off are made nigh by the blood of Christ.

verses.text: Now may he who supplies seed to the sower and bread for food, supply and multiply your seed for sowing, and increase the fruits of your righteousness…
verses.meaning: The God who gives seed for planting and bread for eating also supplies what you need to keep doing good.
verses.kjv: Now he that ministereth seed to the sower both minister bread for your food, and multiply your seed sown, and increase the fruits of your righteousness;)

verses.text: You also helping together on our behalf by your supplication; that, for the gift given to us by means of many, thanks may be given by many persons on your behalf.
verses.meaning: Your prayers really help others. When many pray, many get to thank God for the answer.
verses.kjv: Ye also helping together by prayer for us, that for the gift bestowed upon us by the means of many persons thanks may be given by many on our behalf.

verses.text: May the God of peace himself sanctify you completely. May your whole spirit, soul, and body be preserved blameless at the coming of our Lord Jesus Christ.
verses.meaning: Paul prays that the God of peace makes you whole and holy, every part of you, kept until Jesus returns.
verses.kjv: And the very God of peace sanctify you wholly; and I pray God your whole spirit and soul and body be preserved blameless unto the coming of our Lord Jesus Christ.

verses.text: Fight the good fight of faith. Take hold of the eternal life to which you were called, and you confessed the good confession in the sight of many witnesses.
verses.meaning: Faith takes effort. Keep fighting the good fight and hold on tight to the life God has called you to.
verses.kjv: Fight the good fight of faith, lay hold on eternal life, where unto thou art also called, and hast professed a good profession before many witnesses.

verses.text: Concerning this thing, I begged the Lord three times that it might depart from me.
verses.meaning: Paul begged God three times to take a painful struggle away. You’re allowed to keep asking.
verses.kjv: For this thing I besought the Lord thrice, that it might depart from me.

verses.text: For every creature of God is good, and nothing is to be rejected if it is received with thanksgiving.
verses.meaning: Food and the good things of daily life come from God. Receive them with thanks, not suspicion or guilt.
verses.kjv: For every creature of God is good, and nothing to be refused, if it be received with thanksgiving…

verses.text: May the Lord make you to increase and abound in love toward one another and toward all men, even as we also do toward you…
verses.meaning: Paul’s prayer for you: may your love keep spilling over, to fellow believers and to everyone else too.
verses.kjv: And the Lord make you to increase and abound in love one toward another, and toward all men, even as we do toward you…

verses.text: For am I now seeking the favor of men, or of God? Or am I striving to please men? For if I were still pleasing men, I wouldn’t be a servant of Christ.
verses.meaning: You can’t live for God’s approval and everyone’s likes at once. Paul chose to serve Christ, not applause.
verses.kjv: For do I now persuade men, or God? or do I seek to please men? for if I yet pleased men, I should not be the servant of Christ.

verses.text: ‘Six days shall work be done, but on the seventh day is a Sabbath of solemn rest, a holy convocation; you shall do no kind of work. It is a Sabbath to the LORD in all your dwellings.’
verses.meaning: Sabbath rest was meant for every home: one day a week set apart for God, with the work put down.
verses.kjv: Six days shall work be done: but the seventh day is the sabbath of rest, an holy convocation; ye shall do no work therein: it is the sabbath of the LORD in all your dwellings.

verses.text: But sanctify the Lord God in your hearts. Always be ready to give an answer to everyone who asks you a reason concerning the hope that is in you, with humility and fear…
verses.meaning: Be ready to gently explain why you have hope. Your calm trust might be what someone needs to hear.
verses.kjv: But sanctify the Lord God in your hearts: and be ready always to give an answer to every man that asketh you a reason of the hope that is in you with meekness and fear…

verses.text: Namely, that God was in Christ reconciling the world to himself, not reckoning to them their trespasses, and having committed to us the word of reconciliation.
verses.meaning: In Jesus, God came to make peace with the world, not to hold its wrongs against it.
verses.kjv: To wit, that God was in Christ, reconciling the world unto himself, not imputing their trespasses unto them; and hath committed unto us the word of reconciliation.

verses.text: When they bring you before the synagogues, the rulers, and the authorities, don’t be anxious how or what you will answer or what you will say; for the Holy Spirit will teach you in that same hour what you must say.
verses.meaning: Worried you won’t know what to say when you’re put on the spot for your faith? The Spirit will help you.
verses.kjv: And when they bring you unto the synagogues, and unto magistrates, and powers, take ye no thought how or what thing ye shall answer, or what ye shall say: For the Holy Ghost shall teach you in the same hour what ye ought to say.

verses.text: I therefore run like that, not aimlessly. I fight like that, not beating the air…
verses.meaning: Paul didn’t run without a finish line or throw punches at the air. Know what you’re aiming at today.
verses.kjv: I therefore so run, not as uncertainly; so fight I, not as one that beateth the air…

verses.text: And put on the new man, who in the likeness of God has been created in righteousness and holiness of truth.
verses.meaning: Like changing clothes, step into the new self God created in you, made to reflect his goodness.
verses.kjv: And that ye put on the new man, which after God is created in righteousness and true holiness.

verses.text: But I have all things and abound. I am filled, having received from Epaphroditus the things that came from you, a sweet-smelling fragrance, an acceptable and well-pleasing sacrifice to God.
verses.meaning: Paul said he had more than enough because friends had shared with him. God often cares for us through others.
verses.kjv: But I have all, and abound: I am full, having received of Epaphroditus the things which were sent from you, an odour of a sweet smell, a sacrifice acceptable, wellpleasing to God.

verses.text: You fathers, don’t provoke your children to wrath, but nurture them in the discipline and instruction of the Lord.
verses.meaning: Fathers, and all parents: don’t push your kids to anger. Raise them with patient care and the Lord’s ways.
verses.kjv: And, ye fathers, provoke not your children to wrath: but bring them up in the nurture and admonition of the Lord.

verses.text: Follow after peace with all men, and the sanctification without which no man will see the Lord…
verses.meaning: Go after peace with everyone, and after a holy life. Both matter when you walk with God.
verses.kjv: Follow peace with all men, and holiness, without which no man shall see the Lord…

verses.text: He arose, and ate and drank, and went in the strength of that food forty days and forty nights to Horeb, God’s Mountain.
verses.meaning: God fed the exhausted prophet, and Elijah walked forty days on that one meal. God knows what your road needs.
verses.kjv: And he arose, and did eat and drink, and went in the strength of that meat forty days and forty nights unto Horeb the mount of God.

verses.text: Let your gentleness be known to all men. The Lord is at hand.
verses.meaning: The Lord is close at hand. That nearness is where calm, and gentleness with others, can start.
verses.kjv: Let your moderation be known unto all men. The Lord is at hand.

verses.text: Saying, “Amen! Blessing, glory, wisdom, thanksgiving, honor, power, and might, be to our God forever and ever! Amen.”
verses.meaning: In heaven, the angels pile up words of praise and thanks to God and still say amen. He deserves every one.
verses.kjv: Saying, Amen: Blessing, and glory, and wisdom, and thanksgiving, and honour, and power, and might, be unto our God for ever and ever. Amen.

verses.text: May the Lord direct your hearts into God’s love and into the perseverance of Christ.
verses.meaning: A prayer to borrow: Lord, steer my heart deeper into your love and Christ’s steady endurance.
verses.kjv: And the Lord direct your hearts into the love of God, and into the patient waiting for Christ.

verses.text: I therefore, the prisoner in the Lord, beg you to walk worthily of the calling with which you were called…
verses.meaning: Writing from prison, Paul urged believers to live in a way that fits the calling God has given them.
verses.kjv: I therefore, the prisoner of the Lord, beseech you that ye walk worthy of the vocation wherewith ye are called…

verses.text: All Judah rejoiced at the oath, for they had sworn with all their heart and sought him with their whole desire; and he was found by them. Then the LORD gave them rest all around.
verses.meaning: Judah went after God wholeheartedly and found him close. Rest followed, a calm that settled on every side.
verses.kjv: And all Judah rejoiced at the oath: for they had sworn with all their heart, and sought him with their whole desire; and he was found of them: and the LORD gave them rest round about.

verses.text: To an incorruptible and undefiled inheritance that doesn’t fade away, reserved in Heaven for you, who by the power of God are guarded through faith for a salvation ready to be revealed in the last time.
verses.meaning: What God is keeping for you can’t spoil or fade, and his power is guarding you until it arrives.
verses.kjv: To an inheritance incorruptible, and undefiled, and that fadeth not away, reserved in heaven for you, Who are kept by the power of God through faith unto salvation ready to be revealed in the last time.

verses.text: For godly sorrow produces repentance leading to salvation, which brings no regret. But the sorrow of the world produces death.
verses.meaning: Sorrow that turns you toward God leads to new life without regret. Shame on its own only drags you down.
verses.kjv: For godly sorrow worketh repentance to salvation not to be repented of: but the sorrow of the world worketh death.

verses.text: Thomas therefore, who is called Didymus, said to his fellow disciples, “Let’s also go, that we may die with him.”
verses.meaning: Thomas is famous for doubting, but here he chose to follow Jesus into danger, whatever it might cost.
verses.kjv: Then said Thomas, which is called Didymus, unto his fellowdisciples, Let us also go, that we may die with him.

verses.text: Throwing down imaginations and every high thing that is exalted against the knowledge of God and bringing every thought into captivity to the obedience of Christ…
verses.meaning: Don’t let every thought run loose. Catch the ones that pull you from God and bring them to Jesus.
verses.kjv: Casting down imaginations, and every high thing that exalteth itself against the knowledge of God, and bringing into captivity every thought to the obedience of Christ…

verses.text: For you were once darkness, but are now light in the Lord. Walk as children of light…
verses.meaning: You used to be darkness itself; now you’re light because of the Lord. Live like who you are.
verses.kjv: For ye were sometimes darkness, but now are ye light in the Lord: walk as children of light…

verses.text: But having food and clothing, we will be content with that.
verses.meaning: If you have food to eat and clothes to wear, you have enough to be content. Peace doesn’t need more stuff.
verses.kjv: And having food and raiment let us be therewith content.

verses.text: Doing nothing through rivalry or through conceit, but in humility, each counting others better than himself; each of you not just looking to his own things, but each of you also to the things of others.
verses.meaning: Drop the competition and the ego. Put others ahead of yourself, and look out for their needs too.
verses.kjv: Let nothing be done through strife or vainglory; but in lowliness of mind let each esteem other better than themselves. Look not every man on his own things, but every man also on the things of others.

verses.text: But the wisdom that is from above is first pure, then peaceful, gentle, reasonable, full of mercy and good fruits, without partiality, and without hypocrisy.
verses.meaning: Wisdom from God isn’t harsh or showy. It’s peaceful, gentle, open to reason and full of mercy.
verses.kjv: But the wisdom that is from above is first pure, then peaceable, gentle, and easy to be intreated, full of mercy and good fruits, without partiality, and without hypocrisy.

verses.text: But he who endures to the end will be saved.
verses.meaning: Jesus warned his followers that hard days would come, and urged them to hold on to him all the way through.
verses.kjv: But he that shall endure unto the end, the same shall be saved.

verses.text: He is before all things, and in him all things are held together.
verses.meaning: When everything feels like it’s coming apart, Jesus is the one holding all of it together.
verses.kjv: And he is before all things, and by him all things consist.

verses.text: Saying: “We give you thanks, Lord God, the Almighty, the one who is and who was, because you have taken your great power and reigned.”
verses.meaning: Heaven gives thanks that God, who always was and always is, now reigns openly. Your thanks joins theirs.
verses.kjv: Saying, We give thee thanks, O Lord God Almighty, which art, and wast, and art to come; because thou hast taken to thee thy great power, and hast reigned.

verses.text: But the goal of this command is love from a pure heart, a good conscience, and sincere faith…
verses.meaning: The whole point of God’s commands is love: from a clean heart, a clear conscience and honest faith.
verses.kjv: Now the end of the commandment is charity out of a pure heart, and of a good conscience, and of faith unfeigned…

verses.text: For to me to live is Christ, and to die is gain.
verses.meaning: For Paul, living meant Christ and dying meant more of him. When Jesus is your center, nothing is wasted.
verses.kjv: For to me to live is Christ, and to die is gain.

verses.text: Every day Jesus was teaching in the temple, and every night he would go out and spend the night on the mountain that is called Olivet.
verses.meaning: Jesus taught all day, then went out to the hillside each night. Even his work had a rhythm of withdrawing.
verses.kjv: And in the day time he was teaching in the temple; and at night he went out, and abode in the mount that is called the mount of Olives.

verses.text: When the chief Shepherd is revealed, you will receive the crown of glory that doesn’t fade away.
verses.meaning: Caring for others faithfully isn’t wasted. When Jesus the chief Shepherd appears, a lasting glory awaits.
verses.kjv: And when the chief Shepherd shall appear, ye shall receive a crown of glory that fadeth not away.

verses.text: In him we have our redemption through his blood, the forgiveness of our trespasses, according to the riches of his grace
verses.meaning: Your freedom came at a great cost, and God’s forgiveness flows from a grace that never runs dry.
verses.kjv: In whom we have redemption through his blood, the forgiveness of sins, according to the riches of his grace…

verses.text: When they had prayed, the place was shaken where they were gathered together. They were all filled with the Holy Spirit, and they spoke the word of God with boldness.
verses.meaning: After the believers prayed, the Holy Spirit filled them and they spoke about God without holding back.
verses.kjv: And when they had prayed, the place was shaken where they were assembled together; and they were all filled with the Holy Ghost, and they spake the word of God with boldness.

verses.text: So that you may approve the things that are excellent, that you may be sincere and without offense to the day of Christ…
verses.meaning: Learn to tell the excellent from the merely okay. Not every good thing deserves your time and attention.
verses.kjv: That ye may approve things that are excellent; that ye may be sincere and without offence till the day of Christ…

verses.text: Yet now he has reconciled in the body of his flesh through death, to present you holy and without defect and blameless before him…
verses.meaning: Through Jesus’s death, God sees you as holy and spotless, with nothing left against you.
verses.kjv: In the body of his flesh through death, to present you holy and unblameable and unreproveable in his sight…

verses.text: Charge those who are rich in this present age that they not be arrogant, nor have their hope set on the uncertainty of riches, but on the living God, who richly provides us with everything to enjoy…
verses.meaning: Money is unreliable, so don’t anchor your hope there. Trust God, who gives you so much to enjoy.
verses.kjv: Charge them that are rich in this world, that they be not highminded, nor trust in uncertain riches, but in the living God, who giveth us richly all things to enjoy…

verses.text: Even so, affectionately longing for you, we were well pleased to impart to you not the Good News of God only, but also our own souls, because you had become very dear to us.
verses.meaning: Paul didn’t just share a message. He shared his life, because the people had become dear to him.
verses.kjv: So being affectionately desirous of you, we were willing to have imparted unto you, not the gospel of God only, but also our own souls, because ye were dear unto us.

verses.text: Where do wars and fightings among you come from? Don’t they come from your pleasures that war in your members?
verses.meaning: Most fights start inside you: wants that clash in your own heart spill out into conflict.
verses.kjv: From whence come wars and fightings among you? come they not hence, even of your lusts that war in your members?

verses.text: For which I also labor, striving according to his working, which works in me mightily.
verses.meaning: Paul worked hard, but the energy came from Christ working powerfully in him. You can draw on that same power.
verses.kjv: Whereunto I also labour, striving according to his working, which worketh in me mightily.

verses.text: And the Lord will deliver me from every evil work and will preserve me for his heavenly Kingdom. To him be the glory forever and ever. Amen.
verses.meaning: Paul trusted God to carry him safely through every attack and all the way home to his kingdom.
verses.kjv: And the Lord shall deliver me from every evil work, and will preserve me unto his heavenly kingdom: to whom be glory for ever and ever. Amen.

verses.text: He said, “Blessed be the LORD, the God of my master Abraham, who has not forsaken his loving kindness and his truth toward my master. As for me, the LORD has led me on the way to the house of my master’s relatives.”
verses.meaning: When God led Abraham’s servant to the right family, he praised God on the spot. Notice when you’re guided.
verses.kjv: And he said, Blessed be the LORD God of my master Abraham, who hath not left destitute my master of his mercy and his truth: I being in the way, the LORD led me to the house of my master’s brethren.

verses.text: But when the kindness of God our Savior and his love toward mankind appeared, not by works of righteousness which we did ourselves, but according to his mercy, he saved us through the washing of regeneration and renewing by the Holy Spirit…
verses.meaning: God saved you because of his kindness and mercy, not because you earned it with good behavior.
verses.kjv: But after that the kindness and love of God our Saviour toward man appeared, Not by works of righteousness which we have done, but according to his mercy he saved us, by the washing of regeneration, and renewing of the Holy Ghost…

verses.text: Not that I have already obtained, or am already made perfect; but I press on, that I may take hold of that for which also I was taken hold of by Christ Jesus.
verses.meaning: Paul admitted he wasn’t there yet, but kept pressing on toward the reason Jesus took hold of him.
verses.kjv: Not as though I had already attained, either were already perfect: but I follow after, if that I may apprehend that for which also I am apprehended of Christ Jesus.

verses.text: Yes, brother, let me have joy from you in the Lord. Refresh my heart in the Lord.
verses.meaning: Paul wasn’t shy about asking a friend to refresh his heart. It’s okay to say you need encouragement.
verses.kjv: Yea, brother, let me have joy of thee in the Lord: refresh my bowels in the Lord.

verses.text: But, according to his promise, we look for new heavens and a new earth, in which righteousness dwells.
verses.meaning: God promised a new world where what’s right is finally at home. That’s worth looking forward to.
verses.kjv: Nevertheless we, according to his promise, look for new heavens and a new earth, wherein dwelleth righteousness.

verses.text: “Be angry, and don’t sin.” Don’t let the sun go down on your wrath…
verses.meaning: Anger isn’t always wrong, but don’t let it fester. Deal with it before the day is done.
verses.kjv: Be ye angry, and sin not: let not the sun go down upon your wrath…

verses.text: Then Paul answered, “What are you doing, weeping and breaking my heart? For I am ready not only to be bound, but also to die at Jerusalem for the name of the Lord Jesus.”
verses.meaning: Friends begged Paul to stay safe, but he was ready to face prison or worse for Jesus’s sake.
verses.kjv: Then Paul answered, What mean ye to weep and to break mine heart? for I am ready not to be bound only, but also to die at Jerusalem for the name of the Lord Jesus.

verses.text: Walk in wisdom toward those who are outside, redeeming the time.
verses.meaning: Be wise with people outside the faith and use your time well. Each day holds chances you won’t get back.
verses.kjv: Walk in wisdom toward them that are without, redeeming the time.

verses.text: And in him you are made full, who is the head of all principality and power.
verses.meaning: You’re not missing some extra piece. In Christ, you’ve already been made complete.
verses.kjv: And ye are complete in him, which is the head of all principality and power…

verses.text: Seeing that his divine power has granted to us all things that pertain to life and godliness, through the knowledge of him who called us by his own glory and virtue…
verses.meaning: God’s power has already given you what you need to live a life that honors him. You aren’t missing a piece.
verses.kjv: According as his divine power hath given unto us all things that pertain unto life and godliness, through the knowledge of him that hath called us to glory and virtue…

verses.text: We exhort you, brothers: Admonish the disorderly; encourage the faint-hearted; support the weak; be patient toward all.
verses.meaning: Different people need different care: a nudge, encouragement, support. Be patient with everyone.
verses.kjv: Now we exhort you, brethren, warn them that are unruly, comfort the feebleminded, support the weak, be patient toward all men.

verses.text: May mercy, peace, and love be multiplied to you.
verses.meaning: A blessing for you today: mercy, peace and love, not in small doses but multiplied.
verses.kjv: Mercy unto you, and peace, and love, be multiplied.

verses.text: Strengthening the souls of the disciples, exhorting them to continue in the faith, and that through many afflictions we must enter into God’s Kingdom.
verses.meaning: Paul didn’t promise new believers an easy life. He strengthened them to keep the faith through hard times.
verses.kjv: Confirming the souls of the disciples, and exhorting them to continue in the faith, and that we must through much tribulation enter into the kingdom of God.

verses.text: He, in the days of his flesh, having offered up prayers and petitions with strong crying and tears to him who was able to save him from death, and having been heard for his godly fear…
verses.meaning: Jesus prayed with loud cries and tears, and God heard him. Your tears in prayer aren’t too much.
verses.kjv: Who in the days of his flesh, when he had offered up prayers and supplications with strong crying and tears unto him that was able to save him from death, and was heard in that he feared…

verses.text: Jethro said, “Blessed be the LORD, who has delivered you out of the hand of the Egyptians, and out of the hand of Pharaoh; who has delivered the people from under the hand of the Egyptians.”
verses.meaning: Jethro heard how God rescued Israel and praised God himself. Someone else’s good news can fuel your thanks.
verses.kjv: And Jethro said, Blessed be the LORD, who hath delivered you out of the hand of the Egyptians, and out of the hand of Pharaoh, who hath delivered the people from under the hand of the Egyptians.

verses.text: Whom, not having known, you love. In him, though now you don’t see him, yet believing, you rejoice greatly with joy that is unspeakable and full of glory…
verses.meaning: You’ve never seen Jesus, yet you love him. Trusting him brings a joy too deep for words.
verses.kjv: Whom having not seen, ye love; in whom, though now ye see him not, yet believing, ye rejoice with joy unspeakable and full of glory…

verses.text: That you may walk worthily of the Lord, to please him in all respects, bearing fruit in every good work and increasing in the knowledge of God…
verses.meaning: Paul prayed believers would live to please God, bear fruit in good work and keep growing in knowing him.
verses.kjv: That ye might walk worthy of the Lord unto all pleasing, being fruitful in every good work, and increasing in the knowledge of God…

verses.text: Therefore we have been comforted. In our comfort we rejoiced the more exceedingly for the joy of Titus, because his spirit has been refreshed by you all.
verses.meaning: Titus came back refreshed by people who cared for him, and his joy lifted Paul too. Rest spreads.
verses.kjv: Therefore we were comforted in your comfort: yea, and exceedingly the more joyed we for the joy of Titus, because his spirit was refreshed by you all.

verses.text: There will be no night, and they need no lamp light or sun light; for the Lord God will illuminate them. They will reign forever and ever.
verses.meaning: In God’s new world there’s no more night. His own light will shine on his people forever.
verses.kjv: And there shall be no night there; and they need no candle, neither light of the sun; for the Lord God giveth them light: and they shall reign for ever and ever.

verses.text: Who delivered us out of the power of darkness, and translated us into the Kingdom of the Son of his love, in whom we have our redemption, the forgiveness of our sins.
verses.meaning: God pulled you out of the dark into his Son’s kingdom, where you’re set free and your sins are forgiven.
verses.kjv: Who hath delivered us from the power of darkness, and hath translated us into the kingdom of his dear Son: In whom we have redemption through his blood, even the forgiveness of sins…

verses.text: Let’s therefore go out to him outside of the camp, bearing his reproach.
verses.meaning: Following Jesus may cost you comfort and approval. Go to him anyway, even if it puts you outside the crowd.
verses.kjv: Let us go forth therefore unto him without the camp, bearing his reproach.

verses.text: Test all things, and hold firmly that which is good. Abstain from every form of evil.
verses.meaning: Don’t swallow everything you hear. Test it, keep what’s good and step away from what’s evil.
verses.kjv: Prove all things; hold fast that which is good. Abstain from all appearance of evil.

verses.text: Put on therefore, as God’s chosen ones, holy and beloved, a heart of compassion, kindness, lowliness, humility, and perseverance…
verses.meaning: Because God chose you and loves you, wear kindness and humility like your everyday clothes.
verses.kjv: Put on therefore, as the elect of God, holy and beloved, bowels of mercies, kindness, humbleness of mind, meekness, longsuffering…

verses.text: And if a brother or sister is naked and in lack of daily food, and one of you tells them, “Go in peace. Be warmed and filled;” yet you didn’t give them the things the body needs, what good is it?
verses.meaning: Kind words can’t fill an empty stomach. When someone lacks food or clothes, real faith steps in and helps.
verses.kjv: If a brother or sister be naked, and destitute of daily food, And one of you say unto them, Depart in peace, be ye warmed and filled; notwithstanding ye give them not those things which are needful to the body; what doth it profit?

verses.text: Don’t rebuke an older man, but exhort him as a father; the younger men as brothers; the elder women as mothers; the younger as sisters, in all purity.
verses.meaning: Treat people in your church like family: older ones as parents, younger ones as brothers and sisters.
verses.kjv: Rebuke not an elder, but intreat him as a father; and the younger men as brethren; The elder women as mothers; the younger as sisters, with all purity.

verses.text: So he sent his brothers away, and they departed. He said to them, “See that you don’t quarrel on the way.”
verses.meaning: Joseph had just forgiven his brothers, and his parting advice was simple: don’t fight on the way home.
verses.kjv: So he sent his brethren away, and they departed: and he said unto them, See that ye fall not out by the way.

verses.text: But you, brothers, don’t be weary in doing what is right.
verses.meaning: Doing the right thing can get tiring and thankless. Keep at it anyway; it still matters to God.
verses.kjv: But ye, brethren, be not weary in well doing.

verses.text: And might deliver all of them who through fear of death were all their lifetime subject to bondage.
verses.meaning: Jesus came to free people from a lifelong fear of death. That fear doesn’t have to hold you anymore.
verses.kjv: And deliver them who through fear of death were all their lifetime subject to bondage.

verses.text: David said to Abigail, “Blessed is the LORD, the God of Israel, who sent you today to meet me!”
verses.meaning: David thanked God for Abigail, who talked him out of revenge. Thank God for people who stop you from mistakes.
verses.kjv: And David said to Abigail, Blessed be the LORD God of Israel, which sent thee this day to meet me…

verses.text: Seeing you have purified your souls in your obedience to the truth through the Spirit in sincere brotherly affection, love one another from the heart fervently…
verses.meaning: Since God has made you new, love other believers with your whole heart, warmly and for real.
verses.kjv: Seeing ye have purified your souls in obeying the truth through the Spirit unto unfeigned love of the brethren, see that ye love one another with a pure heart fervently…

verses.text: For by him all things were created in the heavens and on the earth, visible things and invisible things, whether thrones or dominions or principalities or powers. All things have been created through him and for him.
verses.meaning: Everything was made through Jesus and for him, including you. Your life finds its meaning in him.
verses.kjv: For by him were all things created, that are in heaven, and that are in earth, visible and invisible, whether they be thrones, or dominions, or principalities, or powers: all things were created by him, and for him…

verses.text: But the LORD is in his holy temple. Let all the earth be silent before him!
verses.meaning: Unlike lifeless idols, the living God is present. Sometimes the best response is to be quiet before him.
verses.kjv: But the LORD is in his holy temple: let all the earth keep silence before him.

verses.text: He who testifies these things says, “Yes, I am coming soon.” Amen! Yes, come, Lord Jesus!
verses.meaning: The Bible closes on a promise and a prayer: Jesus says he’s coming soon, and his people long for that day.
verses.kjv: He which testifieth these things saith, Surely I come quickly. Amen. Even so, come, Lord Jesus.

verses.text: You were dead through your trespasses and the uncircumcision of your flesh. He made you alive together with him, having forgiven us all our trespasses, wiping out the handwriting in ordinances which was against us. He has taken it out of the way, nailing it to the cross.
verses.meaning: Every charge against you was nailed to the cross with Jesus. The debt is canceled, the record wiped clean.
verses.kjv: And you, being dead in your sins and the uncircumcision of your flesh, hath he quickened together with him, having forgiven you all trespasses; Blotting out the handwriting of ordinances that was against us, which was contrary to us, and took it out of the way, nailing it to his cross…

verses.text: By faith Moses, when he was born, was hidden for three months by his parents, because they saw that he was a beautiful child; and they were not afraid of the king’s commandment.
verses.meaning: Moses’s parents defied a cruel king’s order to protect their baby. Faith gave them the nerve to do right.
verses.kjv: By faith Moses, when he was born, was hid three months of his parents, because they saw he was a proper child; and they were not afraid of the king’s commandment.

verses.text: But refuse profane and old wives’ fables. Exercise yourself toward godliness. For bodily exercise has some value, but godliness has value in all things, having the promise of the life which is now and of that which is to come.
verses.meaning: Gym time helps your body, but training in godliness helps every part of life, now and forever.
verses.kjv: But refuse profane and old wives’ fables, and exercise thyself rather unto godliness. For bodily exercise profiteth little: but godliness is profitable unto all things, having promise of the life that now is, and of that which is to come.

verses.text: We know, brothers loved by God, that you are chosen…
verses.meaning: Paul was sure of it: you’re loved by God and chosen by him. That part is already settled.
verses.kjv: Knowing, brethren beloved, your election of God.

verses.text: The Spirit and the bride say, “Come!” He who hears, let him say, “Come!” He who is thirsty, let him come. He who desires, let him take the water of life freely.
verses.meaning: The Bible’s last invitation: anyone who’s thirsty can come and take the water of life, completely free.
verses.kjv: And the Spirit and the bride say, Come. And let him that heareth say, Come. And let him that is athirst come. And whosoever will, let him take the water of life freely.

verses.text: Having been reminded of the sincere faith that is in you, which lived first in your grandmother Lois and your mother Eunice and, I am persuaded, in you also.
verses.meaning: Timothy’s faith was first lived out by his grandmother and mother. Faith at home can shape generations.
verses.kjv: When I call to remembrance the unfeigned faith that is in thee, which dwelt first in thy grandmother Lois, and thy mother Eunice; and I am persuaded that in thee also.

verses.text: The day following, he appeared to them as they fought, and urged them to be at peace again, saying, ‘Sirs, you are brothers. Why do you wrong one another?’
verses.meaning: Moses stepped between two men fighting: you’re brothers, so why hurt each other? It’s still worth asking.
verses.kjv: And the next day he shewed himself unto them as they strove, and would have set them at one again, saying, Sirs, ye are brethren; why do ye wrong one to another?

verses.text: The man said, “Let me go, for the day breaks.” Jacob said, “I won’t let you go unless you bless me.”
verses.meaning: Jacob wrestled all night and refused to let go without a blessing. Hold on to God when it’s hard.
verses.kjv: And he said, Let me go, for the day breaketh. And he said, I will not let thee go, except thou bless me.

verses.text: Is any among you suffering? Let him pray. Is any cheerful? Let him sing praises.
verses.meaning: Hurting? Pray. Glad? Sing. Whatever you feel today, you can take it straight to God.
verses.kjv: Is any among you afflicted? let him pray. Is any merry? let him sing psalms.

verses.text: I will sing to the LORD as long as I live. I will sing praise to my God while I have any being.
verses.meaning: Marveling at all God made, the psalmist vows to sing for life. Let wonder at creation turn into praise.
verses.kjv: I will sing unto the LORD as long as I live: I will sing praise to my God while I have my being.

verses.text: We know that we have passed out of death into life, because we love the brothers. He who doesn’t love his brother remains in death.
verses.meaning: Loving other believers is a sure sign that you’ve passed from death into real life.
verses.kjv: We know that we have passed from death unto life, because we love the brethren. He that loveth not his brother abideth in death.

verses.text: Tell Archippus, “Take heed to the ministry which you have received in the Lord, that you fulfill it.”
verses.meaning: Paul sent a personal nudge to Archippus: finish the work God gave you. It’s a good nudge for you too.
verses.kjv: And say to Archippus, Take heed to the ministry which thou hast received in the Lord, that thou fulfil it.

verses.text: It will happen in the day that the LORD will give you rest from your sorrow, from your trouble, and from the hard service in which you were made to serve…
verses.meaning: God promised a day of rest from sorrow, trouble and hard labor. Your heaviest seasons don’t get the last word.
verses.kjv: And it shall come to pass in the day that the LORD shall give thee rest from thy sorrow, and from thy fear, and from the hard bondage wherein thou wast made to serve…

verses.text: He said to me, “I am the Alpha and the Omega, the Beginning and the End. I will give freely to him who is thirsty from the spring of the water of life.”
verses.meaning: Jesus, the beginning and the end, offers life like fresh spring water, freely, to anyone who’s thirsty.
verses.kjv: And he said unto me, It is done. I am Alpha and Omega, the beginning and the end. I will give unto him that is athirst of the fountain of the water of life freely.

verses.text: Bearing with one another, and forgiving each other, if any man has a complaint against any; even as Christ forgave you, so you also do.
verses.meaning: Be patient with each other’s flaws, and forgive the way Christ forgave you: fully and freely.
verses.kjv: Forbearing one another, and forgiving one another, if any man have a quarrel against any: even as Christ forgave you, so also do ye.

verses.text: But if one of you suffers for being a Christian, let him not be ashamed; but let him glorify God in this matter.
verses.meaning: If you suffer for following Jesus, there’s no shame in it. Let it become a way to honor God.
verses.kjv: Yet if any man suffer as a Christian, let him not be ashamed; but let him glorify God on this behalf.

verses.text: No soldier on duty entangles himself in the affairs of life, that he may please him who enrolled him as a soldier.
verses.meaning: A soldier on duty doesn’t get tangled in side affairs. Stay free of distractions that pull you off mission.
verses.kjv: No man that warreth entangleth himself with the affairs of this life; that he may please him who hath chosen him to be a soldier.

verses.text: For both he who sanctifies and those who are sanctified are all from one, for which cause he is not ashamed to call them brothers…
verses.meaning: Jesus isn’t embarrassed by you. He gladly calls you his brother or sister.
verses.kjv: For both he that sanctifieth and they who are sanctified are all of one: for which cause he is not ashamed to call them brethren…

verses.text: But don’t forget to be doing good and sharing, for with such sacrifices God is well pleased.
verses.meaning: Sharing what you have with others is an offering God loves. Don’t let busy days crowd out doing good.
verses.kjv: But to do good and to communicate forget not: for with such sacrifices God is well pleased.

verses.text: The things which you have heard from me among many witnesses, commit the same things to faithful men who will be able to teach others also.
verses.meaning: Pass on what you’ve learned about faith to people who will teach others. Faith grows through mentoring.
verses.kjv: And the things that thou hast heard of me among many witnesses, the same commit thou to faithful men, who shall be able to teach others also.

verses.text: I exhort Euodia, and I exhort Syntyche, to think the same way in the Lord.
verses.meaning: Paul urged two coworkers in the church who were at odds to agree in the Lord. Peace with friends is worth it.
verses.kjv: I beseech Euodias, and beseech Syntyche, that they be of the same mind in the Lord.

verses.text: That he would grant you, according to the riches of his glory, that you may be strengthened with power through his Spirit in the inner person…
verses.meaning: Paul prays that God’s Spirit would make you strong on the inside, in the places no one else can see.
verses.kjv: That he would grant you, according to the riches of his glory, to be strengthened with might by his Spirit in the inner man…

verses.text: Therefore let them also who suffer according to the will of God in doing good entrust their souls to him, as to a faithful Creator.
verses.meaning: When doing right still brings pain, you can hand your whole self over to God, your faithful Creator.
verses.kjv: Wherefore let them that suffer according to the will of God commit the keeping of their souls to him in well doing, as unto a faithful Creator.

verses.text: He laid his hands on her, and immediately she stood up straight and glorified God.
verses.meaning: Bent over for eighteen years, she stood tall at Jesus’s touch, and her first move was to praise God.
verses.kjv: And he laid his hands on her: and immediately she was made straight, and glorified God.

verses.text: By this we know love, because he laid down his life for us. And we ought to lay down our lives for the brothers.
verses.meaning: Jesus showed what love really is by giving his life. Real love puts others first, even at a cost.
verses.kjv: Hereby perceive we the love of God, because he laid down his life for us: and we ought to lay down our lives for the brethren.

verses.text: And that you make it your ambition to lead a quiet life, and to do your own business, and to work with your own hands, even as we instructed you, that you may walk properly toward those who are outside, and may have need of nothing.
verses.meaning: A calm, honest, hardworking life is a worthy goal. It quietly earns respect from the people watching.
verses.kjv: And that ye study to be quiet, and to do your own business, and to work with your own hands, as we commanded you; That ye may walk honestly toward them that are without, and that ye may have lack of nothing.

verses.text: May the LORD repay your work, and a full reward be given to you from the LORD, the God of Israel, under whose wings you have come to take refuge.
verses.meaning: Boaz blessed Ruth, a widow far from home, for taking shelter under God’s wings. You can rest there too.
verses.kjv: The LORD recompense thy work, and a full reward be given thee of the LORD God of Israel, under whose wings thou art come to trust.

verses.text: Therefore you now have sorrow, but I will see you again, and your heart will rejoice, and no one will take your joy away from you.
verses.meaning: Sorrow is real now, but Jesus promised a joy that no one will ever be able to take from you.
verses.kjv: And ye now therefore have sorrow: but I will see you again, and your heart shall rejoice, and your joy no man taketh from you.

verses.text: The saying is faithful and worthy of all acceptance, that Christ Jesus came into the world to save sinners, of whom I am chief.
verses.meaning: Paul called himself the worst of sinners, and that’s exactly who Jesus came to save. No one is too far gone.
verses.kjv: This is a faithful saying, and worthy of all acceptation, that Christ Jesus came into the world to save sinners; of whom I am chief.

verses.text: They overcame him because of the Lamb’s blood, and because of the word of their testimony. They didn’t love their life, even to death.
verses.meaning: God’s people overcome evil through Jesus’s sacrifice and their own testimony, even at great cost.
verses.kjv: And they overcame him by the blood of the Lamb, and by the word of their testimony; and they loved not their lives unto the death.

verses.text: Therefore we ought to pay greater attention to the things that were heard, lest perhaps we drift away.
verses.meaning: Boats drift when no one’s watching. Pay closer attention to God’s truth so you don’t slowly slip away.
verses.kjv: Therefore we ought to give the more earnest heed to the things which we have heard, lest at any time we should let them slip.

verses.text: Of his own will he gave birth to us by the word of truth, that we should be a kind of first fruits of his creatures.
verses.meaning: God chose to give you new life through his word. You’re like the first fruits of a whole new creation.
verses.kjv: Of his own will begat he us with the word of truth, that we should be a kind of firstfruits of his creatures.

verses.text: But he answered them, “You give them something to eat.” They asked him, “Shall we go and buy two hundred denarii worth of bread and give them something to eat?”
verses.meaning: Jesus told his overwhelmed friends to feed the crowd themselves. He often meets needs through your hands.
verses.kjv: He answered and said unto them, Give ye them to eat. And they say unto him, Shall we go and buy two hundred pennyworth of bread, and give them to eat?

verses.text: But exhort one another day by day, so long as it is called “today”, lest any one of you be hardened by the deceitfulness of sin.
verses.meaning: Encourage each other every day. A daily word of support helps keep hearts soft toward God.
verses.kjv: But exhort one another daily, while it is called To day; lest any of you be hardened through the deceitfulness of sin.

verses.text: Violence shall no more be heard in your land, nor desolation or destruction within your borders; but you will call your walls Salvation, and your gates Praise.
verses.meaning: God promises a home where violence is gone for good, and safety and praise surround you on every side.
verses.kjv: Violence shall no more be heard in thy land, wasting nor destruction within thy borders; but thou shalt call thy walls Salvation, and thy gates Praise.

verses.text: Asa cried to the LORD his God, and said, “LORD, there is no one besides you to help, between the mighty and him who has no strength. Help us, LORD our God; for we rely on you, and in your name we have come against this multitude. LORD, you are our God. Don’t let man prevail against you.”
verses.meaning: Badly outnumbered, King Asa admitted only God can help the powerless, and leaned his full weight on him.
verses.kjv: And Asa cried unto the LORD his God, and said, LORD, it is nothing with thee to help, whether with many, or with them that have no power: help us, O LORD our God; for we rest on thee, and in thy name we go against this multitude. O LORD, thou art our God; let not man prevail against thee.

verses.text: For the people will dwell in Zion at Jerusalem. You will weep no more. He will surely be gracious to you at the voice of your cry. When he hears you, he will answer you.
verses.meaning: God is gracious at the sound of your cry. The moment he hears you, he answers.
verses.kjv: For the people shall dwell in Zion at Jerusalem: thou shalt weep no more: he will be very gracious unto thee at the voice of thy cry; when he shall hear it, he will answer thee.

verses.text: At the end of the days I, Nebuchadnezzar, lifted up my eyes to heaven, and my understanding returned to me; and I blessed the Most High, and I praised and honored him who lives forever, for his dominion is an everlasting dominion, and his kingdom from generation to generation.
verses.meaning: When the proud king’s mind was restored, he looked up and praised God. Humility clears the way for thanks.
verses.kjv: And at the end of the days I Nebuchadnezzar lifted up mine eyes unto heaven, and mine understanding returned unto me, and I blessed the most High, and I praised and honoured him that liveth for ever, whose dominion is an everlasting dominion, and his kingdom is from generation to generation…

verses.text: By this God’s love was revealed in us, that God has sent his only born Son into the world that we might live through him.
verses.meaning: God proved his love by sending his Son, so that you could truly live through him.
verses.kjv: In this was manifested the love of God toward us, because that God sent his only begotten Son into the world, that we might live through him.

verses.text: For this cause, I remind you that you should stir up the gift of God which is in you through the laying on of my hands.
verses.meaning: Paul told Timothy to rekindle his God-given gift. What God put in you is worth using, not shelving.
verses.kjv: Wherefore I put thee in remembrance that thou stir up the gift of God, which is in thee by the putting on of my hands.

verses.text: Remain in me, and I in you. As the branch can’t bear fruit by itself unless it remains in the vine, so neither can you, unless you remain in me.
verses.meaning: Fruit doesn’t come from straining harder. It comes from staying connected to Jesus, like a branch on a vine.
verses.kjv: Abide in me, and I in you. As the branch cannot bear fruit of itself, except it abide in the vine; no more can ye, except ye abide in me.

verses.text: Yet a little while, and the world will see me no more; but you will see me. Because I live, you will live also.
verses.meaning: Because Jesus is alive, you will live too. His resurrection is your future.
verses.kjv: Yet a little while, and the world seeth me no more; but ye see me: because I live, ye shall live also.

verses.text: Let’s draw near with a true heart in fullness of faith, having our hearts sprinkled from an evil conscience and having our body washed with pure water…
verses.meaning: With a guilty conscience washed clean, you can come close to God with confidence instead of dread.
verses.kjv: Let us draw near with a true heart in full assurance of faith, having our hearts sprinkled from an evil conscience, and our bodies washed with pure water.

verses.text: Be subject therefore to God. Resist the devil, and he will flee from you.
verses.meaning: Yield to God first, then push back against the devil. He’s the one who has to run, not you.
verses.kjv: Submit yourselves therefore to God. Resist the devil, and he will flee from you.

verses.text: Therefore, holy brothers, partakers of a heavenly calling, consider the Apostle and High Priest of our confession: Jesus…
verses.meaning: When your mind wanders, bring it back to Jesus. Think hard about who he is and what he’s done.
verses.kjv: Wherefore, holy brethren, partakers of the heavenly calling, consider the Apostle and High Priest of our profession, Christ Jesus…
